```text
<div class="post about-home">

              {% else %}
                {% assign profile_image_class = 'img-fluid rounded' %}
              {% endif %}
              {% capture sizes %}(min-width: 768px) 280px, 180px{% endcapture %}
              {%
                include figure.liquid
                loading="eager"
                fetchpriority="high"

                path=profile_image_path

                sizes=sizes
                alt=page.profile.alt

            {% if page.profile.more_info %}

          </div>
        </div>
```

Read publication entry template and font tokens

`cat _layouts/bib.liquid && grep -n "fs-base\|fs-sm\|fs-xs\|fs-lg\|max-content-width" _sass/_tokens.scss _sass/_variables.scss _config.yml | head`

```text
---
---
<div class="row publication-row{% if site.enable_publication_thumbnails %} publication-row--with-media{% endif %}">
  {% if site.enable_publication_thumbnails %}
    <div class="pub-media abbr">
      {%- if entry.abbr -%}
        {% assign venue_data = site.data.venues[entry.abbr] %}
        <abbr class="rounded{% if venue_data.emphasis == 'strong' %} venue--strong{% endif %}">
          {% if site.data.venues[entry.abbr].url %}
            <a href="{{ site.data.venues[entry.abbr].url }}">{{ entry.abbr }}</a>
          {% else %}
            <div>{{- entry.abbr -}}</div>
          {% endif %}
        </abbr>
      {% endif %}
      {% if entry.preview %}
        {% if entry.preview contains '://' %}
          <img class="preview rounded" src="{{ entry.preview }}" loading="lazy" decoding="async" alt="{{ entry.title | strip_html | escape }}">
        {% else %}
          {% assign entry_path = entry.preview | prepend: '/assets/img/publication_preview/' %}
          {% assign still_path = entry.preview | prepend: '/assets/img/publication_preview/still/' %}
          {% capture has_still %}{% file_exists {{ still_path }} %}{% endcapture %}
          {% unless has_still == 'true' %}{% assign still_path = null %}{% endunless %}
          {%
            include figure.liquid
            loading="lazy"
            path=entry_path
            reduced_motion_path=still_path
            sizes = "280px"
            class="preview rounded"
            zoomable=true
            alt=entry.title
          %}
        {% endif %}
      {% endif %}
    </div>
  {% endif %}

  <!-- Entry bib key -->
  <div id="{{ entry.key }}" class="pub-content">
    <!-- Title -->
    <div class="title">
      {% if entry.selected %}<span class="selected-dot" aria-label="Selected"></span>{% endif %}
      {{ entry.title }}
    </div>
    <!-- Author -->
    <div class="author">
      {% assign author_array_size = entry.author_array | size %}

      {% assign author_array_limit = author_array_size %}
      {% if site.max_author_limit and author_array_size > site.max_author_limit %}
        {% assign author_array_limit = site.max_author_limit %}
      {% endif %}

      {%- for author in entry.author_array limit: author_array_limit -%}
        {% assign author_is_self = false %}
        {%- assign author_last_name = author.last | regex_replace: '[*∗†‡§¶‖&^]', '' -%}
        {%- assign author_last_html = author.last | regex_replace: '([*∗†‡§¶‖&^]+)', '<sup>\1</sup>' -%}
        {% if site.scholar.last_name contains author_last_name %}
          {% if site.scholar.first_name contains author.first %}
            {% assign author_is_self = true %}
          {% endif %}
        {%- endif -%}
        {% assign coauthor_url = null %}
        {%- assign clean_last_name = author_last_name | downcase | remove_accents -%}
        {% if site.data.coauthors[clean_last_name] %}
          {%- for coauthor in site.data.coauthors[clean_last_name] -%}
            {% if coauthor.firstname contains author.first %}
              {%- assign coauthor_url = coauthor.url -%}
              {% break %}
            {% endif %}
          {% endfor %}
        {%- endif -%}

        {%- if forloop.length > 1 -%}
          {% if forloop.first == false %},&nbsp;{% endif %}
          {%- if forloop.last and author_array_limit == author_array_size %}and&nbsp;{% endif -%}
        {% endif %}
        {%- if author_is_self -%}
          <strong class="author-self">
            {{- author.first }}
            {{ author_last_html -}}
          </strong>
        {%- else -%}
          {%- if coauthor_url -%}
            <a href="{{ coauthor_url }}">
              {{- author.first }}
              {{ author_last_html -}}
            </a>
          {%- else -%}
            {{- author.first }}
            {{ author_last_html -}}
          {% endif %}
        {%- endif -%}
      {% endfor %}
      {%- assign more_authors = author_array_size | minus: author_array_limit -%}

      {%- assign more_authors_hide = more_authors | append: ' more author' -%}
      {% if more_authors > 0 %}
        {%- if more_authors > 1 -%}
          {% assign more_authors_hide = more_authors_hide | append: 's' %}
        {%- endif -%}
        {% assign more_authors_show = '' %}
        {%- for author in entry.author_array offset: author_array_limit -%}
          {% assign more_authors_show = more_authors_show | append: author.first | append: ' ' | append: author.last %}
          {% unless forloop.last %}
            {% assign more_authors_show = more_authors_show | append: ', ' %}
          {% endunless %}
        {%- endfor -%}
        {%- assign more_authors_show = more_authors_show | regex_replace: '([*∗†‡§¶‖&^]+)', '<sup>\1</sup>' -%}
        , and
        <button
          type="button"
          class="more-authors"
          title="Show {{ more_authors_hide }}"
          aria-expanded="false"
          data-collapsed-text="{{ more_authors_hide | escape }}"
          data-expanded-text="{{ more_authors_show | strip_html | escape }}"
        >
          {{- more_authors_hide -}}
        </button>
      {% endif %}
      {% if entry.annotation %}
        <i
          class="fa-solid fa-circle-info ml-1"
          data-toggle="popover"
          data-placement="top"
          data-html="true"
          data-content="{{ entry.annotation | escape }}"
        >
        </i>
      {% endif %}
    </div>
    {% if entry.summary %}
      <p class="pub-summary">{{ entry.summary }}</p>
    {% endif %}

    <!-- Journal/Book title and date -->
    {% assign proceedings = 'inproceedings,incollection' | split: ',' %}
    {% assign thesis = 'thesis,mastersthesis,phdthesis' | split: ',' %}
    {% if entry.type == 'article' %}
      {% capture entrytype %}<em class="venue">{{ entry.journal }}</em>{% endcapture %}
    {% elsif proceedings contains entry.type %}
      {% capture entrytype %}<em class="venue">In {{ entry.booktitle }}</em>{% endcapture %}
    {% elsif thesis contains entry.type %}
      {% capture entrytype %}<em class="venue">{{ entry.school }}</em>{% endcapture %}
    {% else %}
      {% capture entrytype %}{% endcapture %}
    {% endif %}
    {% if entry.month %}
      {% capture entrymonth %}{{ " " }}{{ entry.month | capitalize }}{% endcapture %}
    {% endif %}
    {% if entry.year %}
      {% capture entryyear %}{{ " " }}{{ entry.year }}{% endcapture %}
    {% endif %}
    {% if entry.location %}
      {% capture entrytype %}{{ entrytype }}{{ " · " }}{{ entry.location }}{% endcapture %}
    {% endif -%}
    {% if entry.additional_info %}
      {% capture entrytype %}{{ entrytype }}{{ entry.additional_info | markdownify | remove: '<p>' | remove: '</p>' }}{% endcapture %}
    {% endif %}
    {% capture hook_exists %}{% file_exists _includes/hook/bib.liquid %}{% endcapture %}
    {% if hook_exists == 'true' %}
      {% include hook/bib.liquid %}
    {% endif %}
    {% assign entrytype_text = entrytype | strip_html | strip %}
    {% capture periodical %}{{ entrytype }}{% if entrytype_text != "" and entryyear != "" %} · {% endif %}{{ entrymonth }}{{ entryyear }}{% endcapture %}
    <div class="periodical">
      {{ periodical | strip }}
    </div>
    <div class="periodical">
      {{ entry.note | strip }}
    </div>

    <!-- Links and publication metrics share one wrapping action region. -->
    <div class="pub-actions">
      <div class="pub-links">
        {% if entry.award %}
          <button type="button" class="award" aria-expanded="false">
            {%- if entry.award_name %}{{ entry.award_name }}{% else %}Awarded{% endif -%}
          </button>
        {% endif %}
        {% if entry.doi %}
          <a href="https://doi.org/{{ entry.doi }}">DOI</a>
        {% endif %}
        {% if entry.html %}
          {% if entry.html contains '://' %}
            <a href="{{ entry.html }}">Paper</a>
          {% else %}
            <a href="{{ entry.html | prepend: '/assets/html/' | relative_url }}">Paper</a>
          {% endif %}
        {% elsif entry.arxiv %}
          <a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/{{ entry.arxiv }}">Paper</a>
        {% endif %}
        {% if entry.pdf %}
          {% if entry.pdf contains '://' %}
            <a href="{{ entry.pdf }}">PDF</a>
          {% else %}
            <a href="{{ entry.pdf | prepend: '/assets/pdf/' | relative_url }}">PDF</a>
          {% endif %}
        {% endif %}
        {% if entry.supp %}
          {% if entry.supp contains '://' %}
            <a href="{{ entry.supp }}">Supp</a>
          {% else %}
            <a href="{{ entry.supp | prepend: '/assets/pdf/' | relative_url }}">Supp</a>
          {% endif %}
        {% endif %}
        {% if entry.blog %}
          <a href="{{ entry.blog }}">Blog</a>
        {% endif %}
        {% if entry.code %}
          <a href="{{ entry.code }}">Code</a>
        {% endif %}
        {% if entry.poster %}
          {% if entry.poster contains '://' %}
            <a href="{{ entry.poster }}">Poster</a>
          {% else %}
            <a href="{{ entry.poster | prepend: '/assets/pdf/' | relative_url }}">Poster</a>
          {% endif %}
        {% endif %}
        {% if entry.slides %}
          {% if entry.slides contains '://' %}
            <a href="{{ entry.slides }}">Slides</a>
          {% else %}
            <a href="{{ entry.slides | prepend: '/assets/pdf/' | relative_url }}">Slides</a>
          {% endif %}
        {% endif %}
        {% if entry.website %}
          <a href="{{ entry.website }}">Website</a>
        {% endif %}
      </div>
      {% if site.enable_publication_badges %}
        {% assign entry_has_altmetric_badge = false %}
        {% if entry.altmetric and entry.altmetric != 'false' %}
          {% assign entry_has_altmetric_badge = true %}
        {% endif %}

        {% assign entry_has_dimensions_badge = false %}
        {% if entry.dimensions and entry.dimensions != 'false' %}
          {% assign entry_has_dimensions_badge = true %}
        {% endif %}

        {% assign entry_has_google_scholar_badge = false %}
        {% if entry.google_scholar_id %}
          {% assign entry_has_google_scholar_badge = true %}
        {% endif %}

        {% assign entry_has_github_stars_badge = false %}
        {% if entry.github_repo %}
          {% assign entry_has_github_stars_badge = true %}
        {% endif %}

        {% assign entry_has_inspirehep_badge = false %}
        {% if entry.inspirehep_id %}
          {% assign entry_has_inspirehep_badge = true %}
        {% endif %}
        {% if entry_has_altmetric_badge
          or entry_has_dimensions_badge
          or entry_has_google_scholar_badge
          or entry_has_github_stars_badge
          or entry_has_inspirehep_badge
        %}
          <div class="badges">
            {% if site.enable_publication_badges.altmetric and entry_has_altmetric_badge %}
              <span
                class="altmetric-embed"
                data-badge-type="2"
                data-badge-popover="right"
                {% if entry.altmetric != blank and entry.altmetric != 'true' %}
                  data-altmetric-id="{{ entry.altmetric }}"
                {% elsif entry.arxiv %}
                  data-arxiv-id="{{ entry.arxiv }}"
                {% elsif entry.eprint %}
                  data-arxiv-id="{{ entry.eprint }}"
                {% elsif entry.doi %}
                  data-doi="{{ entry.doi }}"
                {% elsif entry.pmid %}
                  data-pmid="{{ entry.pmid }}"
                {% elsif entry.isbn %}
                  data-isbn="{{ entry.isbn }}"
                {% endif %}
              ></span>
            {% endif %}
            {% if site.enable_publication_badges.dimensions and entry_has_dimensions_badge %}
              <span
                class="__dimensions_badge_embed__"
                {% if entry.dimensions != blank and entry.dimensions != 'true' %}
                  data-id="{{ entry.dimensions }}"
                {% elsif entry.doi %}
                  data-doi="{{ entry.doi }}"
                {% else %}
                  data-pmid="{{ entry.pmid }}"
                {% endif %}
                data-style="small_rectangle"
                data-legend="hover-right"
                style="margin-bottom: 3px;"
              ></span>
            {% endif %}
            {% if site.enable_publication_badges.google_scholar and entry_has_google_scholar_badge %}
              {% assign gs_count = site.data.scholar_citations.articles[entry.google_scholar_id] %}
              {% if gs_count != null %}
                <a
                  class="badge-pill"
                  href="https://scholar.google.com/citations?view_op=view_citation&hl=en&user={{ site.scholar_userid }}&citation_for_view={{ site.scholar_userid }}:{{ entry.google_scholar_id }}"
                  aria-label="Google Scholar citations"
                  role="button"
                >
                  <span class="badge-pill__label"> <i class="ai ai-google-scholar"></i> Scholar </span>
                  <span class="badge-pill__value">{{ gs_count }}</span>
                </a>
              {% endif %}
            {% endif %}
            {% if site.enable_publication_badges.github_stars and entry_has_github_stars_badge %}
              {% assign star_count = site.data.github_stars.repos[entry.github_repo] %}
              {% if star_count != null %}
                <a
                  class="badge-pill"
                  href="https://github.com/{{ entry.github_repo }}"
                  aria-label="GitHub repository stars"
                  role="button"
                >
                  <span class="badge-pill__label"> <i class="fa-brands fa-github"></i> GitHub </span>
                  <span class="badge-pill__value">{{ star_count }} ★</span>
                </a>
              {% endif %}
            {% endif %}
            {% if site.enable_publication_badges.inspirehep and entry_has_inspirehep_badge %}
              <a
                href="https://inspirehep.net/literature/{{ entry.inspirehep_id }}"
                aria-label="Inspirehep link"
                role="button"
              >
                <img
                  src="https://img.shields.io/badge/inspire-{% inspirehep_citations entry.inspirehep_id %}-001628?logo=inspire&logoColor=001628&labelColor=beige"
                  alt="{% inspirehep_citations entry.inspirehep_id %} InspireHEP citations"
                  loading="lazy"
                  decoding="async"
                >
              </a>
            {% endif %}
          </div>
        {% endif %}
      {% endif %}
    </div>

    {% if entry.award %}
      <!-- Hidden Award block -->
      <div class="award hidden d-print-inline">
        <p>{{ entry.award | markdownify }}</p>
      </div>
    {% endif %}

    {% if entry.bibtex_show %}
      <!-- Hidden bibtex block -->
      <div class="bibtex hidden">
        {% highlight bibtex %}
        {{- entry.bibtex | hideCustomBibtex -}}
        {% endhighlight %}
      </div>
    {% endif %}

    {% if entry.video and site.enable_video_embedding %}
      <!-- Hidden video block -->
      <div class="abstract hidden">
        <div style="text-align: center;">{% include video.liquid path=entry.video class="img-fluid rounded z-depth-1" controls=true %}</div>
      </div>
    {% endif %}
  </div>
</div>
```

```text
36-  abstract={Ensuring safe decision-making in autonomous vehicles remains a fundamental challenge despite rapid advances in end-to-end learning approaches. Traditional reinforcement learning (RL) methods rely on manually engineered rewards or sparse collision signals, which fail to capture the rich contextual understanding required for safe driving and make unsafe exploration unavoidable in real-world settings. Recent vision-language models (VLMs) offer promising semantic understanding capabilities; however, their high inference latency and susceptibility to hallucination hinder direct application to real-time vehicle control. To address these limitations, this paper proposes DriveVLM-RL, a neuroscience-inspired framework that integrates VLMs into RL through a dual-pathway architecture for safe and deployable autonomous driving. The framework decomposes semantic reward learning into a Static Pathway for continuous spatial safety assessment using CLIP-based contrasting language goals, and a Dynamic Pathway for attention-gated multi-frame semantic risk reasoning using a lightweight detector and a large VLM. A hierarchical reward synthesis mechanism fuses semantic signals with vehicle states, while an asynchronous training pipeline decouples expensive VLM inference from environment interaction. All VLM components are used only during offline training and are removed at deployment, ensuring real-time feasibility. Experiments in the CARLA simulator show significant improvements in collision avoidance, task success, and generalization across diverse traffic scenarios, including strong robustness under settings without explicit collision penalties. These results demonstrate that DriveVLM-RL provides a practical paradigm for integrating foundation models into autonomous driving without compromising real-time feasibility.},
37-  annotation={* Equal Contribution<br>✉ Corresponding Author},
38-  selected={true}
39-}
```

**Research 区的四张子图用什么布局？（先用统一的灰色占位图，之后你只需替换 front matter 里的图片路径）**

Options:
- **2×2 网格 + 小标题 (推荐)** - 四张图两行两列，每张下方一行小字说明，默认对应你的 4 个研究点（Closed-loop sim / VLA / Human-AI / Multi-agent），手机上变成单列
- **2×2 网格，无小标题** - 只有四张图，靠上方的列表文字说明
- **1×4 单行** - 四张小图排成一行（每张约 260px 宽），平板上变 2×2，手机上变单列

**把 “Research” 改成 “My research focuses on:” 之后，用哪种字号？（注意：你简介第二段也是以 “My research focuses on …” 开头，下一轮我会问是否要改）**

Options:
- **与其他大标题一致 (推荐)** - 40px，和 “Selected Publications”、“Recent News” 一样，全页标题节奏统一
- **较小的引导句** - 约 22px 半粗，读起来像是接着简介往下说，存在感比其他大标题弱

**Paper / Code / Scholar / GitHub 这些按钮用哪种苹果风格？**

Options:
- **分层：主按钮实心蓝 (推荐)** - Paper 用苹果蓝实心胶囊；Code/PDF/Website 用蓝色描边胶囊；Scholar/GitHub 指标用浅灰实心胶囊加图标和数字。层级最清楚，最像 apple.com
- **全部蓝色描边胶囊** - 所有按钮同一样式：蓝色细边框 + 蓝字 + 图标，比现在醒目，但没有主次之分
- **全部浅灰实心胶囊** - 苹果的次级按钮样式（#e8e8ed 底 + 深色字 + 图标），比现在醒目，但整体更安静

**论文缩略图放到多宽？（现在 220px。图片会按原始比例显示，去掉边框和白边。注意：vtt24.webp 原图只有 200px 宽，sim2realad 只有 480px，放大后在视网膜屏上会有点软，想要更清晰的话之后可能需要换高分辨率的预览图）**

- **360px** - 图片最大，文字栏缩到约 720px，标题会多换行

Options:

- **简介仍在下方，缩小照片** - 保持现有结构，照片从 300px 缩到约 220px、左栏顶部对齐、减小简介上边距。间距会变小但仍受照片高度限制

```markdown
# 首页布局与论文展示修正

## Context
首页有几处布局问题：间距过大、断行不对，论文卡片也不够醒目。已找到根因：
- **图标→简介空白过大、名字离顶部远**：`.about-hero` 网格只放了名字和照片（`align-items: center`），简介 `.about-hero__bio` 在网格之外。照片（约 332px）比左栏文字（约 180px）高，所以左栏在照片高度内被垂直居中下推约 76px，简介又要排到照片下面再加 48px。
- **图标横向间距大**：每个图标占 44px 的框，再加 8px gap，图标间距 52px（字形 26px）；第一个图标比文字左缘缩进约 9px。
- **“Wisconsin-Madison / CEE” 错误换行**：`.about-subtitle { max-width: 42ch }` 刚好卡在整行宽度附近。
- **模块间距大**：`.home-section { margin-top: 96px }`；首页第一篇论文的 `li` 还有 32px 上内边距。
- **缩略图边框和白边**：`.preview` 固定成 4:3，用 `object-fit: contain`，加白底和 hairline 边框；列宽只有 220px。
- **JICV 等缩写有底色**：`.venue--strong` 加了浅蓝底和描边，所有缩写都有 `2px 8px` 内边距（和缩略图左缘不齐）。

## 已确认的决定（三轮问答）
- 简介移到照片左侧，照片顶部对齐名字；手机上顺序为 名字→图标→照片→简介
- Research 标题改为 “My research focuses on:”，40px，和其他大标题一致；简介第二段开头改为 “I work on …”
- 研究图改为 **2×2 网格 + 小标题**（对应 4 个研究点），先用灰色占位图
- 模块间距 96→**48px**（手机 64→40px）
- 论文缩略图 220→**320px**，按原比例显示，无边框无白边（保留圆角）
- 期刊缩写：**纯苹果蓝文字**，去底框和渐变，缩写内容不变
- 期刊名那行（摘要下方）加大加深
- 按钮分层：**Paper = 实心蓝胶囊**；Code/PDF/Website 等 = 蓝描边胶囊；Scholar/GitHub = 浅灰实心胶囊；引用数为 0 时只显示 “Scholar”
- “All publications ›” 用**苹果蓝文字链接，21px**
- 论文样式由 `bib.liquid` 共用，**/publications/ 页面同步生效**

## 执行：两个并行 opus 子 agent（改动文件互不重叠）

   - `.bio.about-hero__bio`：`grid-area: bio; margin-top: 0`（保留 `max-width: 760px`，宽度随栏自适应）
   - 平板（768–991px）和手机：`grid-template-areas: "header" "media" "bio"`；删掉手机上的 `.about-hero__bio { margin-top }`
   - 把 `.about-hero__bio` 加进现有的入场动画选择器（prepared/started/reduced-motion/print），和 header 同步，避免简介先于名字出现
2. **图标**：`.about-home .about-social` 的 margin-top 改为 `$sp-3`；`.contact-icons` 设 `gap: 0; margin-left: -7px`（让第一个字形和文字左缘对齐）；`a` 改为 40×40。
3. **副标题**：删除 `.about-subtitle` 的 `max-width: 42ch`；`about.md` 副标题里用 `<span class="text-nowrap">Wisconsin-Madison CEE</span>` 包住（Bootstrap 工具类，已在 `assets/css/bootstrap.min.css` 中确认）。

   - 模板里 h2 改为 `{{ page.research.title | default: 'Research' }}`；把单张 figure 换成 `<div class="research-figures">` 循环调用现有的 `_includes/figure.liquid`，传入 `caption`、`zoomable=true`、`sizes`
   - SCSS：`.research-figures` 两列 grid，`gap: $sp-5`，`margin-top: $sp-6`；图片 `aspect-ratio: 16/10; object-fit: cover; border-radius: $r-md`；figcaption 用 `$fs-sm`、`--mono-meta-color`；<576px 改为单列。删除不再使用的 `.research-block__figure` 和 `> figure` 规则
   - 占位 SVG：1600×1000，中性灰半透明矩形加一个简单图片图标，深浅色主题下都能看；`research_overview.jpg` 保留不删
5. **简介措辞**：`about.md` 第二段 “My research focuses on autonomous driving …” → “I work on autonomous driving …”，其余不动。

7. **All publications**：`about.liquid` 文字改为 `All publications<span aria-hidden="true">&nbsp;›</span>`；`.home-more a` 改为 21px、`$fw-medium`、`var(--global-theme-color)`，hover 时下划线。
8. **缩写渐变清理**：删除 `@supports` 中 `.publications .abbr abbr …` 的两段渐变规则（否则 `color: transparent !important` 会让包 B 的纯蓝不可见），以及只被它们用到的 `--venue-gradient-*` / `--venue-strong-gradient-*` 变量（两个主题块都删）。print/forced-colors 块保留。

### 包 B：论文（`_layouts/bib.liquid`、`_sass/_base.scss`、`_sass/_themes.scss`）
1. **主题变量**（`_themes.scss` 浅色和深色块）：`--pub-primary-bg: #0071e3; --pub-primary-hover: #0077ed; --pub-metric-bg`（浅色 `#e8e8ed` / 深色 `#3a3a3c`）；`--pub-metric-hover` 用略深一档的颜色。
2. **缩略图**（`_base.scss` 中 `ol.bibliography > li`）：`.publication-row--with-media` 改为 `320px minmax(0,1fr)`；`.preview` 和 `.preview img` 去掉 `border`、`background`、`aspect-ratio`、`object-fit`，保留 `width:100%; height:auto; border-radius: $r-md`。手机上 `.pub-media` 改为 `width: min(100%, 320px)`。`bib.liquid` 中 `sizes` 280→320px。
3. **缩写**：`.abbr abbr` 改为 `padding: 0; border: 0; color: var(--global-theme-color) !important`；链接 hover 用 `--global-hover-color`。删掉 `.venue--strong` 的底色和描边规则（模板里的 class 保留，无副作用）。
4. **期刊名那行**：`.periodical` 改为 `$fs-base`（17px）；`.venue` 改为 `font-style: normal; font-weight: $fw-semibold; color: var(--global-text-color)`；年份仍用灰色（继承 `.periodical` 的颜色）。
5. **按钮**：
   - `.pub-links a/button`（次级）：胶囊（`border-radius: 980px`），`1px solid var(--global-theme-color)`，蓝字，15px 半粗，`min-height: 36px; padding: 0 16px; gap: 6px`；hover 时蓝底白字
   - 主按钮：`bib.liquid` 中三处 “Paper” 链接加 `class="pub-link--primary"`，样式为 `--pub-primary-bg` 底、白字、同色边框，hover 用 `--pub-primary-hover`
   - 图标：在 `bib.liquid` 中给 Paper / PDF / Code / Website 加 `<i aria-hidden="true">`，分别是 `fa-solid fa-file-lines` / `fa-file-pdf` / `fa-code` / `fa-globe`
   - `.badge-pill`（Scholar/GitHub）：同样的胶囊尺寸，`--pub-metric-bg` 底，无边框，正文颜色，hover 用 `--pub-metric-hover`
```

```text
<div class="post about-home">
  <div class="about-hero">
    <header class="post-header about-header about-hero__header">
      <h1 class="post-title about-title gradient-title">
        {% if site.title == 'blank' %}
          <span class="font-weight-bold">{{ site.first_name }}</span> {{ site.middle_name }}
          {{ site.last_name }}
        {% else %}
          {{ site.title }}
        {% endif %}
      </h1>

      <div class="desc about-subtitle">{{ page.subtitle }}</div>

      {% if page.social %}
        <div class="social about-social">
          <div class="contact-icons">{% include social.liquid %}</div>
          <div class="contact-note">{{ site.contact_note }}</div>
        </div>
      {% endif %}

      {% if site.newsletter.enabled and site.footer_fixed %}
        {% include scripts/newsletter.liquid center=true %}
      {% endif %}
    </header>

    {% if page.profile %}
      <div class="about-hero__media">
        <div class="profile">
          <div class="profile__card">
            {% if page.profile.image %}
              {% assign profile_image_path = page.profile.image | prepend: 'assets/img/' %}
              {% if page.profile.image_circular %}
                {% assign profile_image_class = 'img-fluid rounded-circle' %}
              {% else %}
                {% assign profile_image_class = 'img-fluid rounded' %}
              {% endif %}
              {% capture sizes %}(min-width: 768px) 280px, 180px{% endcapture %}
              {%
                include figure.liquid
                loading="eager"
                fetchpriority="high"
                width="1000"
                height="1000"
                path=profile_image_path
                class=profile_image_class
                sizes=sizes
                alt=page.profile.alt
                cache_bust=true
              %}
            {% endif %}
            {% if page.profile.more_info %}
              <div class="more-info">{{ page.profile.more_info }}</div>
            {% endif %}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    {% endif %}
  </div>

  <div class="bio about-hero__bio">{{ content }}</div>

  <article class="about-home__content">
    {% if page.research %}
      <section class="home-section research-block" data-reveal>
        <h2 class="home-section__title">Research</h2>
        <div class="row">
          {% for g in page.research.groups %}
            <div class="col-md-6">
              <p class="research-block__group">{{ g.title }}</p>
              <ul>
                {% for item in g.items %}
                  <li>{{ item }}</li>
                {% endfor %}
              </ul>
            </div>
          {% endfor %}
        </div>
        {% assign rpath = page.research.image | prepend: 'assets/img/' %}
        {% include figure.liquid path=rpath class="img-fluid rounded research-block__figure" width="1600" height="1034" sizes="(min-width: 1180px) 1116px, calc(100vw - 40px)" alt=page.research.alt zoomable=true %}
      </section>
    {% endif %}

    {% if page.selected_papers %}

        <p class="home-more">
          <a href="{{ '/publications/' | relative_url }}">All publications →</a>
        </p>
      </section>
    {% endif %}

    {% if page.news and site.announcements.enabled %}
      <section class="home-section recent-news" data-reveal>
        <h2 class="home-section__title">
          <a href="{{ '/news/' | relative_url }}">Recent News</a>
        </h2>
        {% include news.liquid limit=true %}
      </section>
    {% endif %}
  </article>

  <div class="footer__ornament">
    <div class="footer__ornament-map">

        async
        type="text/javascript"
        id="clustrmaps"
        src="//clustrmaps.com/map_v2.js?d=iWTm2HbayeimtnXDADURqs5_Im3_wek8M_WS3lq5qLI&cl=ffffff&w=a"
```

Read bib layout, main.scss, and theme selectors

```text
---
---
<div class="row publication-row{% if site.enable_publication_thumbnails %} publication-row--with-media{% endif %}">
  {% if site.enable_publication_thumbnails %}
    <div class="pub-media abbr">
      {%- if entry.abbr -%}
        {% assign venue_data = site.data.venues[entry.abbr] %}
        <abbr class="rounded{% if venue_data.emphasis == 'strong' %} venue--strong{% endif %}">
          {% if site.data.venues[entry.abbr].url %}
            <a href="{{ site.data.venues[entry.abbr].url }}">{{ entry.abbr }}</a>
          {% else %}
            <div>{{- entry.abbr -}}</div>
          {% endif %}
        </abbr>
      {% endif %}
      {% if entry.preview %}
        {% if entry.preview contains '://' %}
          <img class="preview rounded" src="{{ entry.preview }}" loading="lazy" decoding="async" alt="{{ entry.title | strip_html | escape }}">
        {% else %}
          {% assign entry_path = entry.preview | prepend: '/assets/img/publication_preview/' %}
          {% assign still_path = entry.preview | prepend: '/assets/img/publication_preview/still/' %}
          {% capture has_still %}{% file_exists {{ still_path }} %}{% endcapture %}
          {% unless has_still == 'true' %}{% assign still_path = null %}{% endunless %}
          {%
            include figure.liquid
            loading="lazy"
            path=entry_path
            reduced_motion_path=still_path
            sizes = "280px"
            class="preview rounded"
            zoomable=true
            alt=entry.title
          %}
        {% endif %}
      {% endif %}
    </div>
  {% endif %}

  <!-- Entry bib key -->
  <div id="{{ entry.key }}" class="pub-content">
    <!-- Title -->
    <div class="title">
      {% if entry.selected %}<span class="selected-dot" aria-label="Selected"></span>{% endif %}
      {{ entry.title }}
    </div>
    <!-- Author -->
    <div class="author">
      {% assign author_array_size = entry.author_array | size %}

      {% assign author_array_limit = author_array_size %}
      {% if site.max_author_limit and author_array_size > site.max_author_limit %}
        {% assign author_array_limit = site.max_author_limit %}
      {% endif %}

      {%- for author in entry.author_array limit: author_array_limit -%}
        {% assign author_is_self = false %}
        {%- assign author_last_name = author.last | regex_replace: '[*∗†‡§¶‖&^]', '' -%}
        {%- assign author_last_html = author.last | regex_replace: '([*∗†‡§¶‖&^]+)', '<sup>\1</sup>' -%}
        {% if site.scholar.last_name contains author_last_name %}
          {% if site.scholar.first_name contains author.first %}
            {% assign author_is_self = true %}
          {% endif %}
        {%- endif -%}
        {% assign coauthor_url = null %}
        {%- assign clean_last_name = author_last_name | downcase | remove_accents -%}
        {% if site.data.coauthors[clean_last_name] %}
          {%- for coauthor in site.data.coauthors[clean_last_name] -%}
            {% if coauthor.firstname contains author.first %}
              {%- assign coauthor_url = coauthor.url -%}
              {% break %}
            {% endif %}
          {% endfor %}
        {%- endif -%}

        {%- if forloop.length > 1 -%}
          {% if forloop.first == false %},&nbsp;{% endif %}
          {%- if forloop.last and author_array_limit == author_array_size %}and&nbsp;{% endif -%}
        {% endif %}
        {%- if author_is_self -%}
          <strong class="author-self">
            {{- author.first }}
            {{ author_last_html -}}
          </strong>
        {%- else -%}
          {%- if coauthor_url -%}
            <a href="{{ coauthor_url }}">
              {{- author.first }}
              {{ author_last_html -}}
            </a>
          {%- else -%}
            {{- author.first }}
            {{ author_last_html -}}
          {% endif %}
        {%- endif -%}
      {% endfor %}
      {%- assign more_authors = author_array_size | minus: author_array_limit -%}

      {%- assign more_authors_hide = more_authors | append: ' more author' -%}
      {% if more_authors > 0 %}
        {%- if more_authors > 1 -%}
          {% assign more_authors_hide = more_authors_hide | append: 's' %}
        {%- endif -%}
        {% assign more_authors_show = '' %}
        {%- for author in entry.author_array offset: author_array_limit -%}
          {% assign more_authors_show = more_authors_show | append: author.first | append: ' ' | append: author.last %}
          {% unless forloop.last %}
            {% assign more_authors_show = more_authors_show | append: ', ' %}
          {% endunless %}
        {%- endfor -%}
        {%- assign more_authors_show = more_authors_show | regex_replace: '([*∗†‡§¶‖&^]+)', '<sup>\1</sup>' -%}
        , and
        <button
          type="button"
          class="more-authors"
          title="Show {{ more_authors_hide }}"
          aria-expanded="false"
          data-collapsed-text="{{ more_authors_hide | escape }}"
          data-expanded-text="{{ more_authors_show | strip_html | escape }}"
        >
          {{- more_authors_hide -}}
        </button>
      {% endif %}
      {% if entry.annotation %}
        <i
          class="fa-solid fa-circle-info ml-1"
          data-toggle="popover"
          data-placement="top"
          data-html="true"
          data-content="{{ entry.annotation | escape }}"
        >
        </i>
      {% endif %}
    </div>
    {% if entry.summary %}
      <p class="pub-summary">{{ entry.summary }}</p>
    {% endif %}

    <!-- Journal/Book title and date -->
    {% assign proceedings = 'inproceedings,incollection' | split: ',' %}
    {% assign thesis = 'thesis,mastersthesis,phdthesis' | split: ',' %}
    {% if entry.type == 'article' %}
      {% capture entrytype %}<em class="venue">{{ entry.journal }}</em>{% endcapture %}
    {% elsif proceedings contains entry.type %}
      {% capture entrytype %}<em class="venue">In {{ entry.booktitle }}</em>{% endcapture %}
    {% elsif thesis contains entry.type %}
      {% capture entrytype %}<em class="venue">{{ entry.school }}</em>{% endcapture %}
    {% else %}
      {% capture entrytype %}{% endcapture %}
    {% endif %}
    {% if entry.month %}
      {% capture entrymonth %}{{ " " }}{{ entry.month | capitalize }}{% endcapture %}
    {% endif %}
    {% if entry.year %}
      {% capture entryyear %}{{ " " }}{{ entry.year }}{% endcapture %}
    {% endif %}
    {% if entry.location %}
      {% capture entrytype %}{{ entrytype }}{{ " · " }}{{ entry.location }}{% endcapture %}
    {% endif -%}
    {% if entry.additional_info %}
      {% capture entrytype %}{{ entrytype }}{{ entry.additional_info | markdownify | remove: '<p>' | remove: '</p>' }}{% endcapture %}
    {% endif %}
    {% capture hook_exists %}{% file_exists _includes/hook/bib.liquid %}{% endcapture %}
    {% if hook_exists == 'true' %}
      {% include hook/bib.liquid %}
    {% endif %}
    {% assign entrytype_text = entrytype | strip_html | strip %}
    {% capture periodical %}{{ entrytype }}{% if entrytype_text != "" and entryyear != "" %} · {% endif %}{{ entrymonth }}{{ entryyear }}{% endcapture %}
    <div class="periodical">
      {{ periodical | strip }}
    </div>
    <div class="periodical">
      {{ entry.note | strip }}
    </div>

    <!-- Links and publication metrics share one wrapping action region. -->
    <div class="pub-actions">
      <div class="pub-links">
        {% if entry.award %}
          <button type="button" class="award" aria-expanded="false">
            {%- if entry.award_name %}{{ entry.award_name }}{% else %}Awarded{% endif -%}
          </button>
        {% endif %}
        {% if entry.doi %}
          <a href="https://doi.org/{{ entry.doi }}">DOI</a>
        {% endif %}
        {% if entry.html %}
          {% if entry.html contains '://' %}
            <a href="{{ entry.html }}">Paper</a>
          {% else %}
            <a href="{{ entry.html | prepend: '/assets/html/' | relative_url }}">Paper</a>
          {% endif %}
        {% elsif entry.arxiv %}
          <a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/{{ entry.arxiv }}">Paper</a>
        {% endif %}
        {% if entry.pdf %}
          {% if entry.pdf contains '://' %}
            <a href="{{ entry.pdf }}">PDF</a>
          {% else %}
            <a href="{{ entry.pdf | prepend: '/assets/pdf/' | relative_url }}">PDF</a>
          {% endif %}
        {% endif %}
        {% if entry.supp %}
          {% if entry.supp contains '://' %}
            <a href="{{ entry.supp }}">Supp</a>
          {% else %}
            <a href="{{ entry.supp | prepend: '/assets/pdf/' | relative_url }}">Supp</a>
          {% endif %}
        {% endif %}
        {% if entry.blog %}
          <a href="{{ entry.blog }}">Blog</a>
        {% endif %}
        {% if entry.code %}
          <a href="{{ entry.code }}">Code</a>
        {% endif %}
        {% if entry.poster %}
          {% if entry.poster contains '://' %}
            <a href="{{ entry.poster }}">Poster</a>
          {% else %}
            <a href="{{ entry.poster | prepend: '/assets/pdf/' | relative_url }}">Poster</a>
          {% endif %}
        {% endif %}
        {% if entry.slides %}
          {% if entry.slides contains '://' %}
            <a href="{{ entry.slides }}">Slides</a>
          {% else %}
            <a href="{{ entry.slides | prepend: '/assets/pdf/' | relative_url }}">Slides</a>
          {% endif %}
        {% endif %}
        {% if entry.website %}
          <a href="{{ entry.website }}">Website</a>
        {% endif %}
      </div>
      {% if site.enable_publication_badges %}
        {% assign entry_has_altmetric_badge = false %}
        {% if entry.altmetric and entry.altmetric != 'false' %}
          {% assign entry_has_altmetric_badge = true %}
        {% endif %}

        {% assign entry_has_dimensions_badge = false %}
        {% if entry.dimensions and entry.dimensions != 'false' %}
          {% assign entry_has_dimensions_badge = true %}
        {% endif %}

        {% assign entry_has_google_scholar_badge = false %}
        {% if entry.google_scholar_id %}
          {% assign entry_has_google_scholar_badge = true %}
        {% endif %}

        {% assign entry_has_github_stars_badge = false %}
        {% if entry.github_repo %}

        {% if entry.inspirehep_id %}
          {% assign entry_has_inspirehep_badge = true %}
        {% endif %}
        {% if entry_has_altmetric_badge

        %}
          <div class="badges">

    {% if entry.award %}
      <!-- Hidden Award block -->
      <div class="award hidden d-print-inline">
        <p>{{ entry.award | markdownify }}</p>
      </div>
    {% endif %}

    {% if entry.bibtex_show %}
      <!-- Hidden bibtex block -->
      <div class="bibtex hidden">
        {% highlight bibtex %}
        {{- entry.bibtex | hideCustomBibtex -}}
        {% endhighlight %}
      </div>
    {% endif %}

    {% if entry.video and site.enable_video_embedding %}
      <!-- Hidden video block -->
      <div class="abstract hidden">
        <div style="text-align: center;">{% include video.liquid path=entry.video class="img-fluid rounded z-depth-1" controls=true %}</div>
      </div>
    {% endif %}
  </div>
</div>
```

```text
/*******************************************************************************
 * Themes — consume tokens from _tokens.scss, expose via CSS variables.
 *
 * Neutral light and dark palettes with familiar platform-blue interactions.
 ******************************************************************************/

@use "sass:color";

:root {
  // Surfaces (Claude cream — warmer than prior warm off-white)
  --global-bg-color: #{$cream-bg};
  --global-card-bg-color: #{$n-0};
  --global-code-bg-color: #{$cream-subtle};
  --global-bg-subtle: #{$cream-subtle};

  // Text (Claude near-black + warm meta grey)
  --global-text-color: #{$claude-ink};
  --global-text-color-light: #{$claude-ink-light};

  // Accent — platform blue
  --global-theme-color: #0066cc;
  --global-hover-color: #004f9e;
  --global-hover-text-color: #{$cream-bg};
  --global-highlight-color: #0066cc;
  --global-quote-left: #0066cc;
  --title-gradient-start: #52606f;
  --title-gradient-middle: #1479c9;
  --title-gradient-end: #008b95;

  // Footer
  --global-footer-bg-color: #{$n-900};
  --global-footer-text-color: #{$n-300};
  --global-footer-link-color: #{$n-0};

  --global-distill-app-color: #{$n-500};

  // Lines & dividers (denser on cream so the hairline reads)
  --global-divider-color: #{$hairline-cream};
  --hairline: #{$hairline-cream};
  --mono-meta-color: #{$claude-ink-light};
  --btn-outline: #{$n-400};

  --global-back-to-top-bg-color: rgba(
    #{color.channel($black-color, "red", $space: rgb)},
    #{color.channel($black-color, "green", $space: rgb)},
    #{color.channel($black-color, "blue", $space: rgb)},
    0.4
  );
  --global-back-to-top-text-color: #{$cream-bg};
  --global-newsletter-bg-color: #{$cream-bg};
  --global-newsletter-text-color: #{$claude-ink};

  --global-quoto-block-bg: #fffacd;

  --global-tip-block: #42b983;
  --global-tip-block-bg: #e2f5ec;
  --global-tip-block-text: #215d42;
  --global-tip-block-title: #359469;
  --global-warning-block: #e7c000;
  --global-warning-block-bg: #fff8d8;
  --global-warning-block-text: #6b5900;
  --global-warning-block-title: #b29400;
  --global-danger-block: #c00;
  --global-danger-block-bg: #ffe0e0;
  --global-danger-block-text: #600;
  --global-danger-block-title: #c00;

  #light-toggle-system {
    padding-left: 10px;
    padding-top: 12px;
    display: block;
  }
  #light-toggle-dark {
    display: none;
  }
  #light-toggle-light {
    display: none;
  }

  .repo-img-light {
    display: block;
  }
  .repo-img-dark {
    display: none;
  }

  #back-to-top {
    color: var(--global-back-to-top-text-color);
    background: var(--global-back-to-top-bg-color);
    bottom: $back-to-top-bottom;
    right: $back-to-top-right;
    height: $back-to-top-height;
    width: $back-to-top-width;
    z-index: $back-to-top-z-index;
  }
}

html[data-theme="dark"] {
  // Surfaces — warm dark (Claude-style), not cool ink
  --global-bg-color: #{$warm-dark-bg};
  --global-card-bg-color: #{$warm-dark-card};
  --global-code-bg-color: #{$warm-dark-subtle};
  --global-bg-subtle: #{$warm-dark-subtle};

  // Text — warm light, not pure white
  --global-text-color: #{$warm-dark-text};
  --global-text-color-light: #{$warm-dark-meta};

  // Accent — brighter platform blue for dark surfaces.
  --global-theme-color: #2997ff;
  --global-hover-color: #66b5ff;
  --global-hover-text-color: #{$warm-dark-bg};
  --global-highlight-color: #2997ff;
  --global-quote-left: #2997ff;
  --title-gradient-start: #d7dde5;
  --title-gradient-middle: #63adff;
  --title-gradient-end: #4ddbd3;

  // Footer
  --global-footer-bg-color: #{$warm-dark-card};
  --global-footer-text-color: #{$warm-dark-meta};
  --global-footer-link-color: #{$warm-dark-text};

  --global-distill-app-color: #{$warm-dark-meta};

  // Lines & dividers (warm-dark hairline)
  --global-divider-color: #{$hairline-warm-dark};
  --hairline: #{$hairline-warm-dark};
  --mono-meta-color: #{$warm-dark-meta};
  --btn-outline: #{$warm-dark-meta};

  --global-back-to-top-bg-color: rgba(
    #{color.channel($white-color, "red", $space: rgb)},
    #{color.channel($white-color, "green", $space: rgb)},
    #{color.channel($white-color, "blue", $space: rgb)},
    0.5
  );
  --global-back-to-top-text-color: #{$warm-dark-bg};
  --global-newsletter-bg-color: #{$warm-dark-card};
  --global-newsletter-text-color: #{$warm-dark-text};

  --global-tip-block: #42b983;
  --global-tip-block-bg: #1a2e24;
  --global-tip-block-text: #a9e6c5;
  --global-tip-block-title: #6ad0a0;
  --global-warning-block: #e7c000;
  --global-warning-block-bg: #2b240e;
  --global-warning-block-text: #f1d880;
  --global-warning-block-title: #e7c000;
  --global-danger-block: #e25a5a;
  --global-danger-block-bg: #2b1414;
  --global-danger-block-text: #f28e8e;
  --global-danger-block-title: #e25a5a;

  .repo-img-light {
    display: none;
  }
  .repo-img-dark {
    display: block;
  }
}

html[data-theme-setting="dark"] {
  #light-toggle-system {
    display: none;
  }
  #light-toggle-dark {
    padding-left: 10px;
    padding-top: 12px;
    display: block;
  }
  #light-toggle-light {
    display: none;
  }

  #back-to-top {
    color: var(--global-back-to-top-text-color);
    background: var(--global-back-to-top-bg-color);
  }
}

html[data-theme-setting="light"] {
  #light-toggle-system {
    display: none;
  }
  #light-toggle-dark {
    display: none;
  }
  #light-toggle-light {
    padding-left: 10px;
    padding-top: 12px;
    display: block;
  }
}
```

```text
(() => {
  try {
    const motionQuery = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)");
    if (motionQuery && motionQuery.matches) return;

    const root = document.documentElement;
    let timer;
    let state;

    const cleanup = () => {
      if (timer) window.clearTimeout(timer);
      document.removeEventListener("visibilitychange", monitorVisibility);
    };

    const failOpen = () => {
      state.expired = true;
      cleanup();
      root.classList.remove("home-hero-prepared");
    };

    const monitorVisibility = () => {
      if (timer) window.clearTimeout(timer);
      if (document.visibilityState === "visible") timer = window.setTimeout(failOpen, 2000);
    };

    root.classList.add("home-hero-prepared");
    state = { cleanup, expired: false, started: false };
    document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", monitorVisibility);
    monitorVisibility();
    window.homeHeroState = state;
  } catch (_) {
    document.documentElement.classList.remove("home-hero-prepared");
  }
})();
(() => {
  const selector = "[data-reveal]";
  const pendingClass = "reveal-pending";
  const visibleClass = "reveal-visible";
  const motionQuery = window.matchMedia ? window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)") : { matches: false };
  let observer;
  const heroState = window.homeHeroState;

  const finishHero = () => {
    if (!heroState) return;
    heroState.started = true;
    heroState.cleanup();
    document.documentElement.classList.remove("home-hero-prepared");
    document.documentElement.classList.remove("home-hero-started");
  };

  const startHero = () => {
    if (!heroState || heroState.started || document.visibilityState !== "visible") return;
    if (motionQuery.matches || heroState.expired) {
      finishHero();
      return;
    }
    heroState.started = true;
    heroState.cleanup();
    document.documentElement.classList.add("home-hero-started");
  };

  const reveal = (element) => {
    element.classList.remove(pendingClass);
    element.classList.add(visibleClass);
    if (observer) observer.unobserve(element);
  };

  const revealAll = () => {
    document.querySelectorAll(selector).forEach(reveal);
    if (observer) observer.disconnect();
    observer = undefined;
  };

  const init = () => {
    const elements = [...document.querySelectorAll(selector)];
    if (!elements.length || motionQuery.matches || !("IntersectionObserver" in window)) {
      revealAll();
      return;
    }

    observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => entries.forEach((entry) => entry.isIntersecting && reveal(entry.target)), {
      rootMargin: "0px 0px -8%",
      threshold: 0,
    });

    elements.forEach((element) => {
      const rect = element.getBoundingClientRect();
      if (rect.top < window.innerHeight && rect.bottom > 0) {
        reveal(element);
      } else {
        element.classList.add(pendingClass);
        observer.observe(element);
      }
    });
  };

  document.addEventListener("focusin", (event) => {
    const element = event.target.closest ? event.target.closest(selector) : null;
    if (element) reveal(element);
  });
  if (motionQuery.addEventListener) {
    motionQuery.addEventListener("change", (event) => {
      if (event.matches) {
        finishHero();
        revealAll();
      }
    });
  }

  window.addEventListener("pageshow", startHero);
  document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", startHero);
  if (document.visibilityState === "visible") {
    if (window.requestAnimationFrame) window.requestAnimationFrame(startHero);
    else startHero();
  }

  const safelyInit = () => {
    try {
      init();
    } catch (_) {
      revealAll();
    }
  };

  if (document.readyState === "loading") document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", safelyInit, { once: true });
  else safelyInit();
})();
```

```text
// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Publications — quiet editorial rows, no interface chrome.
//
// Layout: year headers act as sticky gutter labels on desktop (≥992px) and
// inline headers on mobile. Each paper is a hairline row — no boxed card.
// Venue reads as a small grey tag, links as grey text separated by middots,
// counts as one grey line.
// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

.publications {
  margin-top: $sp-4;

  h1 {
    color: var(--global-text-color);
    font-family: $ff-serif;
    font-size: $fs-2xl;
    font-weight: $fw-medium;
    text-align: left;
    margin: $sp-6 0 $sp-4;
  }

  // Scholar / GitHub totals — prominent large figures above search.
  .pub-stats {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: $sp-6;
    font-family: $ff-sans;
    color: var(--global-text-color-light);
    margin: 0 0 $sp-7;

    a {
      display: grid;
      gap: $sp-1;
      min-width: 144px;
      color: var(--global-text-color);
      text-decoration: none;

      strong {
        font-size: 40px;
        font-weight: $fw-semibold;
        line-height: 1;
        letter-spacing: -0.035em;
      }

      span {
        font-size: 14px;
        color: var(--global-text-color-light);
      }

      &:hover {
        color: var(--global-theme-color);
      }
    }
  }

  // Year group header (jekyll-scholar emits <h2 class="bibliography">YEAR</h2>).
  h2.bibliography {
    font-family: $ff-sans;
    font-size: $fs-sm;
    font-weight: $fw-semibold;
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
    color: var(--mono-meta-color);
    text-align: left;
    border: 0;
    padding-top: 0;
    margin: $sp-6 0 $sp-3;
  }

  @media (min-width: 992px) {
    h2.bibliography {
      position: sticky;
      top: 64px; // navbar height (body.fixed-top-nav padding-top in _layout.scss)
      background: var(--global-bg-color);
      z-index: 2;
    }
  }

  ol.bibliography {
    list-style: none;
    padding: 0;
    margin-top: 0;

    > li {
      position: relative;
      padding: $sp-6 0;

      .publication-row {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
        gap: $sp-6;
        margin: 0;
      }

      .publication-row--with-media {
        grid-template-columns: 220px minmax(0, 1fr);
      }

      .pub-media,
      .pub-content {
        min-width: 0;
      }

      .preview {
        width: 100%;
        height: auto;
        aspect-ratio: 4 / 3;
        object-fit: contain;
        background: #fff;
        border: 1px solid var(--hairline);
        border-radius: $r-md;
        box-shadow: none;
      }

      .preview img {
        width: 100%;
        height: auto;
        aspect-ratio: 4 / 3;
        object-fit: contain;
        background: #fff;
        border-radius: $r-md;
        box-shadow: none;
      }

      // Venue tags use gradient text; selected venues may add a pale surface.
      .abbr {
        margin-bottom: $sp-2;

        abbr {
          display: inline-block;
          width: auto;
          margin-bottom: $sp-2;
          padding: 2px $sp-2;
          color: var(--global-text-color-light) !important;
          background: transparent !important;
          border: 1px solid transparent;
          border-radius: $r-md;
          font-family: $ff-sans;
          font-size: $fs-xs;
          font-weight: $fw-semibold;
          letter-spacing: 0.04em;
          text-transform: uppercase;

          a,
          div {
            color: inherit !important;
            text-decoration: none;

            &:hover {
              color: var(--global-theme-color) !important;
              text-decoration: none;
            }
          }

          &.venue--strong {
            background: linear-gradient(105deg, rgba(20, 121, 201, 0.09), rgba(0, 139, 149, 0.1)) !important;
            border-color: rgba(20, 121, 201, 0.28);
          }
        }
      }

      .selected-dot {
        display: inline-block;
        width: 6px;
        height: 6px;
        margin-right: $sp-2;
        border-radius: 50%;
        background: var(--global-theme-color);
        vertical-align: 0.2em;
      }

      .title {
        font-family: $ff-serif;
        font-size: 22px;
        font-weight: $fw-semibold;
        line-height: $lh-heading;
        color: var(--global-text-color);
        margin-bottom: $sp-2;
      }

      .pub-summary {
        max-width: 760px;
        margin: 14px 0 $sp-3;
        padding-left: 14px;
        border-left: 1px solid var(--hairline);
        font-family: $ff-sans;
        font-size: 17px;
        line-height: 1.55;
        color: var(--global-text-color-light);
      }

      .author {
        font-family: $ff-sans;
        font-size: $fs-base;
        color: var(--global-text-color);
        line-height: $lh-snug;
        margin-bottom: 0;

        a {
          color: var(--global-text-color);

          &:hover {
            color: var(--global-theme-color);
          }
        }

        // Legacy self-highlight: bib.liquid originally wrapped the author's
        // own name in <em>. Keep that working for backward-compat.
        // Intentionally NOT tinted — names stay in body color (cultural
        // convention: red on names reads as inauspicious in zh-CN).
        > em {
          font-weight: $fw-bold;
          font-style: normal;
          color: var(--global-text-color);
          border-bottom: 0;
        }

        // New self-highlight: <strong class="author-self"> (after bib.liquid refactor).
        // Same rule: bold charcoal, never accent.
        > strong.author-self,
        strong.author-self {
          font-weight: $fw-bold;
          font-style: normal;
          color: var(--global-text-color);
          border-bottom: 0;
        }

        > .more-authors {
          color: var(--global-text-color-light);
          border-bottom: 1px dashed var(--global-text-color-light);
          cursor: pointer;
          background: transparent;
          border: 0;
          border-bottom: 1px dashed currentColor;
          padding: 0;
          font-family: $ff-sans;
          font-size: $fs-xs;

          &:hover {
            color: var(--global-text-color);
            border-bottom-style: solid;
          }
        }
      }

      // Periodical = venue + middot + month/year. One grey sans line,
      // venue italic inside it, nothing boxed.
      .periodical {
        font-family: $ff-sans;
        font-size: $fs-sm;
        color: var(--mono-meta-color);
        margin-top: $sp-2;
      }

      .venue {
        font-family: $ff-sans;
        font-size: $fs-sm;
        font-style: italic;
        font-weight: $fw-regular;
        color: var(--global-text-color-light);
        letter-spacing: normal;
        margin-right: 0.15em;
      }

      .pub-actions {
        display: flex;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        align-items: center;
        gap: $sp-2;
        margin-top: 14px;
      }

      .pub-links,
      .badges {
        display: flex;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        align-items: center;
        gap: $sp-2;
        margin: 0;
        padding: 0;
      }

      .pub-links {
        a,
        button {
          display: inline-flex;
          align-items: center;
          min-height: 36px;
          padding: 6px $sp-3;
          border: 1px solid var(--hairline);
          border-radius: $r-md;
          background: transparent;
          font-family: $ff-sans;
          font-size: 14px;
          font-weight: $fw-semibold;
          color: var(--global-text-color);
          text-decoration: none;
          cursor: pointer;
          transition: color $dur-base $ease-out;

          &:hover {
            color: var(--global-text-color);
            background: var(--global-bg-subtle);
            border-color: var(--global-text-color-light);
            text-decoration: none;
          }
        }
      }

      .badges {
        > span {
          display: inline-flex;
          align-items: center;
          height: auto;
          padding-right: 0;
          vertical-align: middle;

          &:hover {
            text-decoration: none;
          }
        }
      }

      // Citation and repository metrics share the action treatment.
      .badge-pill {
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: $sp-1;
        min-height: 36px;
        padding: 6px $sp-3;
        border: 1px solid var(--hairline);
        border-radius: $r-md;
        font-family: $ff-sans;
        font-size: 14px;
        font-weight: $fw-semibold;
        letter-spacing: 0;
        line-height: 1.4;
        color: var(--global-text-color);
        background: transparent;
        text-decoration: none;
        transition: color $dur-base $ease-out;

        &:hover {
          color: var(--global-text-color);
          background: var(--global-bg-subtle);
          border-color: var(--global-text-color-light);
          text-decoration: none;
        }

        .badge-pill__label,
        .badge-pill__value {
          display: inline-flex;
          align-items: center;
          gap: $sp-1;
          color: inherit;
          background: transparent;
        }
      }

      // Expand/collapse blocks (abstract, bibtex, award, video).
      .hidden {
        font-size: $fs-sm;
        max-height: 0;
        overflow: hidden;
        text-align: justify;
        transition: max-height $dur-slow $ease-out;

        p {
          line-height: 1.5;
          margin: $sp-2 $sp-3;
        }

        pre {
          font-size: $fs-sm;
          line-height: 1.5;
          padding: $sp-3;
        }
      }

      .hidden.open {
        max-height: 100em;
        transition: max-height $dur-slow $ease-out;
      }

      div.abstract.hidden,
      div.bibtex.hidden {
        border: 1px solid transparent;
        border-radius: $r-md;
      }

      div.abstract.hidden.open,
      div.bibtex.hidden.open {
        border-color: var(--hairline);
        margin-top: $sp-2;
      }
    }

    div.award.hidden {
      border: 1px solid transparent;
    }

    div.award.hidden.open {
      border-color: var(--global-highlight-color);
    }
  }
}

@media (max-width: 767px) {
  body {
    font-size: 16px;
  }

  .post-header .post-title {
    font-size: 30px;
  }

  .publications ol.bibliography > li {
    padding: $sp-5 0;

    .publication-row {

    .pub-media {

      max-width: 100%;
    }

    .title {
      font-size: 20px;
    }

    .pub-summary,
    .author {
      font-size: 16px;

  }

}

:focus-visible {
```

```text
// Reserve the metallic gradient for identity and primary index-page titles.
// Unsupported browsers keep the normal solid heading color declared in base.
@supports (-webkit-background-clip: text) {
  .post-header .post-title.gradient-title {
    width: fit-content;
    max-width: 100%;
    color: transparent;
    background: linear-gradient(105deg, var(--title-gradient-start) 5%, var(--title-gradient-middle) 52%, var(--title-gradient-end) 95%);
    background-clip: text;
    -webkit-background-clip: text;
    -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;

    span {
      color: inherit;
    }
  }

  .publications .abbr abbr a,
  .publications .abbr abbr div {
    color: transparent !important;
    background: linear-gradient(105deg, var(--venue-gradient-start) 4%, var(--venue-gradient-middle) 54%, var(--venue-gradient-end) 96%);
    background-clip: text;
    -webkit-background-clip: text;
    -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
  }

  .publications .abbr abbr.venue--strong a,
  .publications .abbr abbr.venue--strong div {
    background-image: linear-gradient(105deg, var(--venue-strong-gradient-start) 4%, var(--venue-strong-gradient-end) 96%);
  }
}

.home-hero-prepared .about-home .about-hero__header,
.home-hero-prepared .about-home .about-hero__media {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(8px);
}

.home-hero-started .about-home .about-hero__header {
  animation: home-hero-enter 1100ms $ease-out both;
}

.home-hero-started .about-home .about-hero__media {
  animation: home-hero-enter 1100ms $ease-out 200ms both;
}

@keyframes home-hero-enter {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(8px);
  }

  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: none;
  }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .home-hero-prepared .about-home .about-hero__header,
  .home-hero-prepared .about-home .about-hero__media,
```

# Claude in Chrome browser automation

You have access to browser automation tools (mcp__claude-in-chrome__*) for interacting with web pages in Chrome. Follow these guidelines for effective browser automation.

## Loading deferred tools

If the mcp__claude-in-chrome__* tools are deferred (must be loaded via ToolSearch before use), load every tool you expect to need in ONE ToolSearch call — the select query accepts a comma-separated list — never one call per tool. Start with the core set:

Add task-specific tools to the same call when the task obviously needs them: read_console_messages / read_network_requests for debugging, form_input for forms, gif_creator for recordings, javascript_tool for page scripting.

## GIF recording

When performing multi-step browser interactions that the user may want to review or share, use mcp__claude-in-chrome__gif_creator to record them.

You must ALWAYS:
* Capture extra frames before and after taking actions to ensure smooth playback
* Name the file meaningfully to help the user identify it later (e.g., "login_process.gif")

## Console log debugging

You can use mcp__claude-in-chrome__read_console_messages to read console output. Console output may be verbose. If you are looking for specific log entries, use the 'pattern' parameter with a regex-compatible pattern. This filters results efficiently and avoids overwhelming output. For example, use pattern: "[MyApp]" to filter for application-specific logs rather than reading all console output.

## Alerts and dialogs

IMPORTANT: Do not trigger JavaScript alerts, confirms, prompts, or browser modal dialogs through your actions. These browser dialogs block all further browser events and will prevent the extension from receiving any subsequent commands. Instead, when possible, use console.log for debugging and then use the mcp__claude-in-chrome__read_console_messages tool to read those log messages. If a page has dialog-triggering elements:
1. Avoid clicking buttons or links that may trigger alerts (e.g., "Delete" buttons with confirmation dialogs)
2. If you must interact with such elements, warn the user first that this may interrupt the session
3. Use mcp__claude-in-chrome__javascript_tool to check for and dismiss any existing dialogs before proceeding

If you accidentally trigger a dialog and lose responsiveness, inform the user they need to manually dismiss it in the browser.

## Avoid rabbit holes and loops

When using browser automation tools, stay focused on the specific task. If you encounter any of the following, stop and ask the user for guidance:
- Unexpected complexity or tangential browser exploration
- Browser tool calls failing or returning errors after 2-3 attempts
- No response from the browser extension
- Page elements not responding to clicks or input
- Pages not loading or timing out
- Unable to complete the browser task despite multiple approaches

Explain what you attempted, what went wrong, and ask how the user would like to proceed. Do not keep retrying the same failing browser action or explore unrelated pages without checking in first.

## Tab context and session startup

IMPORTANT: At the start of each browser automation session, call mcp__claude-in-chrome__tabs_context_mcp first to get information about the user's current browser tabs. Use this context to understand what the user might want to work with before creating new tabs.

Never reuse tab IDs from a previous/other session. Follow these guidelines:
1. Only reuse an existing tab if the user explicitly asks to work with it
2. Otherwise, create a new tab with mcp__claude-in-chrome__tabs_create_mcp
3. If a tool returns an error indicating the tab doesn't exist or is invalid, call tabs_context_mcp to get fresh tab IDs
4. When a tab is closed by the user or a navigation error occurs, call tabs_context_mcp to see what tabs are available

# 首页布局与论文展示修正

## Context
首页有几处布局问题：间距过大、断行不对，论文卡片也不够醒目。已找到根因：
- **图标→简介空白过大、名字离顶部远**：`.about-hero` 网格只放了名字和照片（`align-items: center`），简介 `.about-hero__bio` 在网格之外。照片（约 332px）比左栏文字（约 180px）高，所以左栏在照片高度内被垂直居中下推约 76px，简介又要排到照片下面再加 48px。
- **图标横向间距大**：每个图标占 44px 的框，再加 8px gap，图标间距 52px（字形 26px）；第一个图标比文字左缘缩进约 9px。
- **“Wisconsin-Madison / CEE” 错误换行**：`.about-subtitle { max-width: 42ch }` 刚好卡在整行宽度附近。
- **模块间距大**：`.home-section { margin-top: 96px }`；首页第一篇论文的 `li` 还有 32px 上内边距。
- **缩略图边框和白边**：`.preview` 固定成 4:3，用 `object-fit: contain`，加白底和 hairline 边框；列宽只有 220px。
- **JICV 等缩写有底色**：`.venue--strong` 加了浅蓝底和描边，所有缩写都有 `2px 8px` 内边距（和缩略图左缘不齐）。

## 已确认的决定（三轮问答）
- 简介移到照片左侧，照片顶部对齐名字；手机上顺序为 名字→图标→照片→简介
- Research 标题改为 “My research focuses on:”，40px，和其他大标题一致；简介第二段开头改为 “I work on …”
- 研究图改为 **2×2 网格 + 小标题**（对应 4 个研究点），先用灰色占位图
- 模块间距 96→**48px**（手机 64→40px）
- 论文缩略图 220→**320px**，按原比例显示，无边框无白边（保留圆角）
- 期刊缩写：**纯苹果蓝文字**，去底框和渐变，缩写内容不变
- 期刊名那行（摘要下方）加大加深
- 按钮分层：**Paper = 实心蓝胶囊**；Code/PDF/Website 等 = 蓝描边胶囊；Scholar/GitHub = 浅灰实心胶囊；引用数为 0 时只显示 “Scholar”
- “All publications ›” 用**苹果蓝文字链接，21px**
- 论文样式由 `bib.liquid` 共用，**/publications/ 页面同步生效**

## 执行：两个并行 opus 子 agent（改动文件互不重叠）

### 包 A：首页（`_layouts/about.liquid`、`_pages/about.md`、`_sass/_layout.scss`、新文件 `assets/img/research/placeholder.svg`）
1. **顶部区域结构**：在 `about.liquid` 中把 `<div class="bio about-hero__bio">` 移进 `.about-hero`，放在 media 之后。SCSS 改动：

```text
"""
Fetch Google Scholar citation data and save to _data/scholar_citations.json.

Usage: python _scripts/fetch_scholar_citations.py
"""

import json
import os
import sys
from datetime import datetime, timezone

import yaml

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Config
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
SCRIPT_DIR = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
REPO_ROOT = os.path.dirname(SCRIPT_DIR)
CONFIG_PATH = os.path.join(REPO_ROOT, "_config.yml")
OUTPUT_PATH = os.path.join(REPO_ROOT, "_data", "scholar_citations.json")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def load_scholar_userid():
    with open(CONFIG_PATH, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        config = yaml.safe_load(f)
    uid = config.get("scholar_userid", "").strip()
    if not uid:
        print("ERROR: scholar_userid not found in _config.yml", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)
    return uid


def fetch_author(scholar_id: str):
    """Try direct fetch first; fall back to free proxies if blocked."""
    from scholarly import scholarly, ProxyGenerator

    # Attempt 1: direct connection
    try:
        print(f"Fetching Google Scholar profile for user: {scholar_id} (direct)...")
        author = scholarly.search_author_id(scholar_id)
        author = scholarly.fill(author, sections=["basics", "publications"])
        return author
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Direct fetch failed: {e}", file=sys.stderr)

    # Attempt 2: free proxies
    try:
        print("Retrying with free proxy...", file=sys.stderr)
        pg = ProxyGenerator()
        pg.FreeProxies()
        scholarly.use_proxy(pg)
        author = scholarly.search_author_id(scholar_id)
        author = scholarly.fill(author, sections=["basics", "publications"])
        return author
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Proxy fetch also failed: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
        return None


def build_output(author: dict, scholar_id: str) -> dict:
    total = author.get("citedby", 0)
    articles = {}

    for pub in author.get("publications", []):
        pub_id = pub.get("author_pub_id", "")
        # pub_id format: "userid:articleid"
        if ":" in pub_id:
            article_id = pub_id.split(":", 1)[1]
            citations = pub.get("num_citations", 0)
            articles[article_id] = citations

    return {
        "total_citations": total,
        "last_updated": datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%d"),
        "articles": articles,
    }


def load_existing() -> dict:
    if os.path.exists(OUTPUT_PATH):
        try:
            with open(OUTPUT_PATH, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                return json.load(f)
        except Exception:
            pass
    return {}


def save_output(data: dict):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(OUTPUT_PATH), exist_ok=True)
    with open(OUTPUT_PATH, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(data, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
        f.write("\n")
    print(f"Saved to {OUTPUT_PATH}")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Main
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def main():
    scholar_id = load_scholar_userid()
    author = fetch_author(scholar_id)

    if author is None:
        print(
            "ERROR: Could not fetch citation data. Keeping existing data unchanged.",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )
        if not os.path.exists(OUTPUT_PATH):
            # No existing data; write empty skeleton so Jekyll doesn't error
            save_output({
                "total_citations": 0,
                "last_updated": datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%d"),
                "articles": {},
            })
        sys.exit(1)
```

```text
"""
Fetch GitHub star counts for repos referenced in papers.bib
and save to _data/github_stars.json.

Usage: python _scripts/fetch_github_stars.py
"""

import json
import os
import re
import sys
import urllib.request
import urllib.error
from datetime import datetime, timezone

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Config
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
SCRIPT_DIR = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
REPO_ROOT = os.path.dirname(SCRIPT_DIR)
BIB_PATH = os.path.join(REPO_ROOT, "_bibliography", "papers.bib")
OUTPUT_PATH = os.path.join(REPO_ROOT, "_data", "github_stars.json")

GITHUB_API = "https://api.github.com/repos/{}"
TOKEN = os.environ.get("GITHUB_TOKEN", "")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def extract_github_repos(bib_path: str) -> list[str]:
    """Extract all github_repo values from a .bib file."""
    pattern = re.compile(r"github_repo\s*=\s*\{([^}]+)\}")
    repos = []
    with open(bib_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        for match in pattern.finditer(f.read()):
            repo = match.group(1).strip()
            if repo and repo not in repos:
                repos.append(repo)
    return repos


def fetch_stars(repo: str) -> int | None:
    """Fetch stargazers_count for a single repo via GitHub REST API."""
    url = GITHUB_API.format(repo)
    headers = {
        "Accept": "application/vnd.github+json",
        "User-Agent": "github-stars-fetcher",
    }
    if TOKEN:
        headers["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {TOKEN}"

    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers=headers)
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=15) as resp:
            data = json.loads(resp.read().decode())
            return data.get("stargazers_count", 0)
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        print(f"  HTTP {e.code} for {repo}: {e.reason}", file=sys.stderr)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"  Error fetching {repo}: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
    return None


def load_existing() -> dict:
    if os.path.exists(OUTPUT_PATH):
        try:
            with open(OUTPUT_PATH, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                return json.load(f)
        except Exception:
            pass
    return {}


def save_output(data: dict):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(OUTPUT_PATH), exist_ok=True)
    with open(OUTPUT_PATH, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(data, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
        f.write("\n")
    print(f"Saved to {OUTPUT_PATH}")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Main
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def main():
    if not os.path.exists(BIB_PATH):
        print(f"ERROR: {BIB_PATH} not found", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)

    repos = extract_github_repos(BIB_PATH)
    if not repos:
        print("No github_repo entries found in papers.bib")
        save_output({
            "total_stars": 0,
            "last_updated": datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%d"),
            "repos": {},
        })
        return

    print(f"Found {len(repos)} repo(s) in papers.bib")
    existing = load_existing()
    existing_repos = existing.get("repos", {})

    result_repos: dict[str, int] = {}
    any_failure = False

    for repo in repos:
        print(f"  Fetching stars for {repo}...")
        stars = fetch_stars(repo)
        if stars is not None:
            result_repos[repo] = stars
            print(f"    -> {stars} stars")
        else:
            any_failure = True
            fallback = existing_repos.get(repo, 0)
            result_repos[repo] = fallback
            print(f"    -> fetch failed, using cached value: {fallback}")

    total = sum(result_repos.values())
    data = {
        "total_stars": total,
        "last_updated": datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%d"),
        "repos": result_repos,
    }

    print(f"Total stars: {total}")
    save_output(data)

    if any_failure:
        print("WARNING: Some repos failed to fetch. Cached values used.", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

```text
    element.classList.add(visibleClass);
```

**引用和 GitHub star 的增长曲线用哪种画风？（位置上我打算把 Publications 页顶部那两个大数字换成两张并排的卡片：大数字 + 曲线。引用按年累计，数据取自 Google Scholar；star 按日期累计，数据取自 GitHub API。两个每周自动更新的脚本会顺带记录历史数据。）**

Options:
- **苹果风平滑曲线 (推荐)** - 同样是 star-history 那种“随时间累计增长”的曲线，但线条干净，线条用 Apple Intelligence 渐变、下方浅色填充，和网站整体风格一致
- **手绘风（和 star-history 一模一样）** - 用 star-history 同作者的 chart.xkcd 库，GitHub README 里常见的手绘漫画感曲线和手写字体。辨识度高，但和苹果风的页面反差较大

**文章标题前的蓝点去掉后，标题怎么排？（蓝点原本用来标记 Publications 页上的精选论文）**

Options:
- **标题可点 + 精选加 Featured (推荐)** - 标题本身就是论文链接，悬停变蓝；字号 22→24px，字距收紧。Publications 页的精选论文在标题上方加一行苹果官网 “New” 式的小字 “Featured”（首页全是精选，所以不显示）
- **标题可点，不标精选** - 标题变链接并放大到 24px，精选论文不再有任何标记
- **只去掉蓝点** - 其余完全不变

**除了缩略图上方的期刊名，Apple Intelligence 彩色渐变还用在哪些地方？（我的原则：只用在小面积的点缀上，不和名字的蓝色渐变抢注意力）** _(select multiple)_

Options:
- **社交图标悬停时 (推荐)** - 邮箱/CV/Scholar/GitHub 等图标平时是灰色，鼠标移上去时填充彩色渐变
- **增长曲线的线条 (推荐)** - 引用/star 曲线用彩色渐变线 + 淡淡的渐变填充
- **Featured 小字** - 如果上一题选了加 Featured，它也用彩色渐变
- **News 日期** - Recent News 的日期用彩色渐变（每条都有，数量较多）

**“My research focuses on:” 我建议用五彩斑斓的黑（深色底子里带一点 Apple Intelligence 的蓝紫粉橙，和身份那一行是同一种颜色）。原因是 40px 的大标题如果用全彩色，会和名字的蓝色渐变抢焦点。其他两个大标题要不要一起改？**

Options:
- **三个标题都用五彩斑斓的黑 (推荐)** - My research focuses on: / Selected Publications / Recent News 统一，页面节奏一致
- **只改 My research focuses on:** - 另外两个标题保持纯黑
- **改用 Apple Intelligence 全彩色** - 只用在 My research focuses on:，更醒目，但会和名字的渐变竞争
