<div class="row publication-row{% if site.enable_publication_thumbnails %} publication-row--with-media{% endif %}">
  {% if site.enable_publication_thumbnails %}
    <div class="pub-media abbr">
      {%- if entry.abbr -%}
        {% assign venue_data = site.data.venues[entry.abbr] %}
        <abbr class="rounded{% if venue_data.emphasis == 'strong' %} venue--strong{% endif %}">
          {% if site.data.venues[entry.abbr].url %}
            <a href="{{ site.data.venues[entry.abbr].url }}">{{ entry.abbr }}</a>
          {% else %}
            <div>{{- entry.abbr -}}</div>
          {% endif %}
        </abbr>
      {% endif %}
      {% if entry.preview %}
        {% if entry.preview contains '://' %}
          <img class="preview rounded" src="{{ entry.preview }}" loading="lazy" decoding="async" alt="{{ entry.title | strip_html | escape }}">
        {% else %}
          {% assign entry_path = entry.preview | prepend: '/assets/img/publication_preview/' %}
          {% assign still_path = entry.preview | prepend: '/assets/img/publication_preview/still/' %}
          {% capture has_still %}{% file_exists {{ still_path }} %}{% endcapture %}
          {% unless has_still == 'true' %}{% assign still_path = null %}{% endunless %}
          {%
            include figure.liquid
            loading="lazy"
            path=entry_path
            reduced_motion_path=still_path
            sizes="320px"
            class="preview rounded"
            zoomable=true
            alt=entry.title
          %}
        {% endif %}
      {% endif %}
    </div>
  {% endif %}

  <!-- Entry bib key -->
  <div id="{{ entry.key }}" class="pub-content">
    <!-- Title -->
    <div class="title">
      {% if entry.selected %}<span class="selected-dot" aria-label="Selected"></span>{% endif %}
      {{ entry.title }}
    </div>
    <!-- Author -->
    <div class="author">
      {% assign author_array_size = entry.author_array | size %}

      {% assign author_array_limit = author_array_size %}
      {% if site.max_author_limit and author_array_size > site.max_author_limit %}
        {% assign author_array_limit = site.max_author_limit %}
      {% endif %}

      {%- for author in entry.author_array limit: author_array_limit -%}
        {% assign author_is_self = false %}
        {%- assign author_last_name = author.last | regex_replace: '[*∗†‡§¶‖&^]', '' -%}
        {%- assign author_last_html = author.last | regex_replace: '([*∗†‡§¶‖&^]+)', '<sup>\1</sup>' -%}
        {% if site.scholar.last_name contains author_last_name %}
          {% if site.scholar.first_name contains author.first %}
            {% assign author_is_self = true %}
          {% endif %}
        {%- endif -%}
        {% assign coauthor_url = null %}
        {%- assign clean_last_name = author_last_name | downcase | remove_accents -%}
        {% if site.data.coauthors[clean_last_name] %}
          {%- for coauthor in site.data.coauthors[clean_last_name] -%}
            {% if coauthor.firstname contains author.first %}
              {%- assign coauthor_url = coauthor.url -%}
              {% break %}
            {% endif %}
          {% endfor %}
        {%- endif -%}

        {%- if forloop.length > 1 -%}
          {% if forloop.first == false %},&nbsp;{% endif %}
          {%- if forloop.last and author_array_limit == author_array_size %}and&nbsp;{% endif -%}
        {% endif %}
        {%- if author_is_self -%}
          <strong class="author-self">
            {{- author.first }}
            {{ author_last_html -}}
          </strong>
        {%- else -%}
          {%- if coauthor_url -%}
            <a href="{{ coauthor_url }}">
              {{- author.first }}
              {{ author_last_html -}}
            </a>
          {%- else -%}
            {{- author.first }}
            {{ author_last_html -}}
          {% endif %}
        {%- endif -%}
      {% endfor %}
      {%- assign more_authors = author_array_size | minus: author_array_limit -%}

      {%- assign more_authors_hide = more_authors | append: ' more author' -%}
      {% if more_authors > 0 %}
        {%- if more_authors > 1 -%}
          {% assign more_authors_hide = more_authors_hide | append: 's' %}
        {%- endif -%}
        {% assign more_authors_show = '' %}
        {%- for author in entry.author_array offset: author_array_limit -%}
          {% assign more_authors_show = more_authors_show | append: author.first | append: ' ' | append: author.last %}
          {% unless forloop.last %}
            {% assign more_authors_show = more_authors_show | append: ', ' %}
          {% endunless %}
        {%- endfor -%}
        {%- assign more_authors_show = more_authors_show | regex_replace: '([*∗†‡§¶‖&^]+)', '<sup>\1</sup>' -%}
        , and
        <button
          type="button"
          class="more-authors"
          title="Show {{ more_authors_hide }}"
          aria-expanded="false"
          data-collapsed-text="{{ more_authors_hide | escape }}"
          data-expanded-text="{{ more_authors_show | strip_html | escape }}"
        >
          {{- more_authors_hide -}}
        </button>
      {% endif %}
      {% if entry.annotation %}
        <i
          class="fa-solid fa-circle-info ml-1"
          data-toggle="popover"
          data-placement="top"
          data-html="true"
          data-content="{{ entry.annotation | escape }}"
        >
        </i>
      {% endif %}
    </div>
    {% if entry.summary %}
      <p class="pub-summary">{{ entry.summary }}</p>
    {% endif %}

    <!-- Journal/Book title and date -->
    {% assign proceedings = 'inproceedings,incollection' | split: ',' %}
    {% assign thesis = 'thesis,mastersthesis,phdthesis' | split: ',' %}
    {% if entry.type == 'article' %}
      {% capture entrytype %}<em class="venue">{{ entry.journal }}</em>{% endcapture %}
    {% elsif proceedings contains entry.type %}
      {% capture entrytype %}<em class="venue">In {{ entry.booktitle }}</em>{% endcapture %}
    {% elsif thesis contains entry.type %}
      {% capture entrytype %}<em class="venue">{{ entry.school }}</em>{% endcapture %}
    {% else %}
      {% capture entrytype %}{% endcapture %}
    {% endif %}
    {% if entry.month %}
      {% capture entrymonth %}{{ " " }}{{ entry.month | capitalize }}{% endcapture %}
    {% endif %}
    {% if entry.year %}
      {% capture entryyear %}{{ " " }}{{ entry.year }}{% endcapture %}
    {% endif %}
    {% if entry.location %}
      {% capture entrytype %}{{ entrytype }}{{ " · " }}{{ entry.location }}{% endcapture %}
    {% endif -%}
    {% if entry.additional_info %}
      {% capture entrytype %}{{ entrytype }}{{ entry.additional_info | markdownify | remove: '<p>' | remove: '</p>' }}{% endcapture %}
    {% endif %}
    {% capture hook_exists %}{% file_exists _includes/hook/bib.liquid %}{% endcapture %}
    {% if hook_exists == 'true' %}
      {% include hook/bib.liquid %}
    {% endif %}
    {% assign entrytype_text = entrytype | strip_html | strip %}
    {% capture periodical %}{{ entrytype }}{% if entrytype_text != "" and entryyear != "" %} · {% endif %}{{ entrymonth }}{{ entryyear }}{% endcapture %}
    <div class="periodical">
      {{ periodical | strip }}
    </div>
    <div class="periodical">
      {{ entry.note | strip }}
    </div>

    <!-- Links and publication metrics share one wrapping action region. -->
    <div class="pub-actions">
      <div class="pub-links">
        {% if entry.award %}
          <button type="button" class="award" aria-expanded="false">
            {%- if entry.award_name %}{{ entry.award_name }}{% else %}Awarded{% endif -%}
          </button>
        {% endif %}
        {% if entry.doi %}
          <a href="https://doi.org/{{ entry.doi }}">DOI</a>
        {% endif %}
        {% if entry.html %}
          {% if entry.html contains '://' %}
            <a class="pub-link--primary" href="{{ entry.html }}"><i class="fa-solid fa-file-lines" aria-hidden="true"></i> Paper</a>
          {% else %}
            <a class="pub-link--primary" href="{{ entry.html | prepend: '/assets/html/' | relative_url }}"
              ><i class="fa-solid fa-file-lines" aria-hidden="true"></i> Paper</a
            >
          {% endif %}
        {% elsif entry.arxiv %}
          <a class="pub-link--primary" href="https://arxiv.org/abs/{{ entry.arxiv }}"
            ><i class="fa-solid fa-file-lines" aria-hidden="true"></i> Paper</a
          >
        {% endif %}
        {% if entry.pdf %}
          {% if entry.pdf contains '://' %}
            <a href="{{ entry.pdf }}"><i class="fa-solid fa-file-pdf" aria-hidden="true"></i> PDF</a>
          {% else %}
            <a href="{{ entry.pdf | prepend: '/assets/pdf/' | relative_url }}"><i class="fa-solid fa-file-pdf" aria-hidden="true"></i> PDF</a>
          {% endif %}
        {% endif %}
        {% if entry.supp %}
          {% if entry.supp contains '://' %}
            <a href="{{ entry.supp }}">Supp</a>
          {% else %}
            <a href="{{ entry.supp | prepend: '/assets/pdf/' | relative_url }}">Supp</a>
          {% endif %}
        {% endif %}
        {% if entry.blog %}
          <a href="{{ entry.blog }}">Blog</a>
        {% endif %}
        {% if entry.code %}
          <a href="{{ entry.code }}"><i class="fa-solid fa-code" aria-hidden="true"></i> Code</a>
        {% endif %}
        {% if entry.poster %}
          {% if entry.poster contains '://' %}
            <a href="{{ entry.poster }}">Poster</a>
          {% else %}
            <a href="{{ entry.poster | prepend: '/assets/pdf/' | relative_url }}">Poster</a>
          {% endif %}
        {% endif %}
        {% if entry.slides %}
          {% if entry.slides contains '://' %}
            <a href="{{ entry.slides }}">Slides</a>
          {% else %}
            <a href="{{ entry.slides | prepend: '/assets/pdf/' | relative_url }}">Slides</a>
          {% endif %}
        {% endif %}
        {% if entry.website %}
          <a href="{{ entry.website }}"><i class="fa-solid fa-globe" aria-hidden="true"></i> Website</a>
        {% endif %}
      </div>
      {% if site.enable_publication_badges %}
        {% assign entry_has_altmetric_badge = false %}
        {% if entry.altmetric and entry.altmetric != 'false' %}
          {% assign entry_has_altmetric_badge = true %}
        {% endif %}

        {% assign entry_has_dimensions_badge = false %}
        {% if entry.dimensions and entry.dimensions != 'false' %}
          {% assign entry_has_dimensions_badge = true %}
        {% endif %}

        {% assign entry_has_google_scholar_badge = false %}
        {% if entry.google_scholar_id %}
          {% assign entry_has_google_scholar_badge = true %}
        {% endif %}

        {% assign entry_has_github_stars_badge = false %}
        {% if entry.github_repo %}
          {% assign entry_has_github_stars_badge = true %}
        {% endif %}

        {% assign entry_has_inspirehep_badge = false %}
        {% if entry.inspirehep_id %}
          {% assign entry_has_inspirehep_badge = true %}
        {% endif %}
        {% if entry_has_altmetric_badge
          or entry_has_dimensions_badge
          or entry_has_google_scholar_badge
          or entry_has_github_stars_badge
          or entry_has_inspirehep_badge
        %}
          <div class="badges">
            {% if site.enable_publication_badges.altmetric and entry_has_altmetric_badge %}
              <span
                class="altmetric-embed"
                data-badge-type="2"
                data-badge-popover="right"
                {% if entry.altmetric != blank and entry.altmetric != 'true' %}
                  data-altmetric-id="{{ entry.altmetric }}"
                {% elsif entry.arxiv %}
                  data-arxiv-id="{{ entry.arxiv }}"
                {% elsif entry.eprint %}
                  data-arxiv-id="{{ entry.eprint }}"
                {% elsif entry.doi %}
                  data-doi="{{ entry.doi }}"
                {% elsif entry.pmid %}
                  data-pmid="{{ entry.pmid }}"
                {% elsif entry.isbn %}
                  data-isbn="{{ entry.isbn }}"
                {% endif %}
              ></span>
            {% endif %}
            {% if site.enable_publication_badges.dimensions and entry_has_dimensions_badge %}
              <span
                class="__dimensions_badge_embed__"
                {% if entry.dimensions != blank and entry.dimensions != 'true' %}
                  data-id="{{ entry.dimensions }}"
                {% elsif entry.doi %}
                  data-doi="{{ entry.doi }}"
                {% else %}
                  data-pmid="{{ entry.pmid }}"
                {% endif %}
                data-style="small_rectangle"
                data-legend="hover-right"
                style="margin-bottom: 3px;"
              ></span>
            {% endif %}
            {% if site.enable_publication_badges.google_scholar and entry_has_google_scholar_badge %}
              {% assign gs_count = site.data.scholar_citations.articles[entry.google_scholar_id] %}
              {% if gs_count != null %}
                <a
                  class="badge-pill"
                  href="https://scholar.google.com/citations?view_op=view_citation&hl=en&user={{ site.scholar_userid }}&citation_for_view={{ site.scholar_userid }}:{{ entry.google_scholar_id }}"
                  aria-label="Google Scholar citations"
                  role="button"
                >
                  <span class="badge-pill__label"> <i class="ai ai-google-scholar"></i> Scholar </span>
                  {% if gs_count > 0 -%}
                    <span class="badge-pill__value">{{ gs_count }}</span>
                  {%- endif %}
                </a>
              {% endif %}
            {% endif %}
            {% if site.enable_publication_badges.github_stars and entry_has_github_stars_badge %}
              {% assign star_count = site.data.github_stars.repos[entry.github_repo] %}
              {% if star_count != null %}
                <a
                  class="badge-pill"
                  href="https://github.com/{{ entry.github_repo }}"
                  aria-label="GitHub repository stars"
                  role="button"
                >
                  <span class="badge-pill__label"> <i class="fa-brands fa-github"></i> GitHub </span>
                  {% if star_count > 0 -%}
                    <span class="badge-pill__value">{{ star_count }} ★</span>
                  {%- endif %}
                </a>
              {% endif %}
            {% endif %}
            {% if site.enable_publication_badges.inspirehep and entry_has_inspirehep_badge %}
              <a
                href="https://inspirehep.net/literature/{{ entry.inspirehep_id }}"
                aria-label="Inspirehep link"
                role="button"
              >
                <img
                  src="https://img.shields.io/badge/inspire-{% inspirehep_citations entry.inspirehep_id %}-001628?logo=inspire&logoColor=001628&labelColor=beige"
                  alt="{% inspirehep_citations entry.inspirehep_id %} InspireHEP citations"
                  loading="lazy"
                  decoding="async"
                >
              </a>
            {% endif %}
          </div>
        {% endif %}
      {% endif %}
    </div>

    {% if entry.award %}
      <!-- Hidden Award block -->
      <div class="award hidden d-print-inline">
        <p>{{ entry.award | markdownify }}</p>
      </div>
    {% endif %}

    {% if entry.bibtex_show %}
      <!-- Hidden bibtex block -->
      <div class="bibtex hidden">
        {% highlight bibtex %}
        {{- entry.bibtex | hideCustomBibtex -}}
        {% endhighlight %}
      </div>
    {% endif %}

    {% if entry.video and site.enable_video_embedding %}
      <!-- Hidden video block -->
      <div class="abstract hidden">
        <div style="text-align: center;">{% include video.liquid path=entry.video class="img-fluid rounded z-depth-1" controls=true %}</div>
      </div>
    {% endif %}
  </div>
</div>
---
layout: page
permalink: /publications/
title: Publications
gradient_title: true
description: <i>To boldly go where no man has gone before.</i>
nav: true
nav_order: 2
---

<div class="publications">
  {% assign total_citations = site.data.scholar_citations.total_citations %}
  {% assign total_stars = site.data.github_stars.total_stars %}
  <div class="pub-stats" aria-label="Publication impact">
    {% if total_citations != null %}
      <a href="https://scholar.google.com/citations?user={{ site.scholar_userid }}">
        <strong>{{ total_citations }}</strong>
        <span>Citations</span>
      </a>
    {% endif %}
    {% if total_stars != null %}
      <a href="https://github.com/{{ site.github_username }}">
        <strong>{{ total_stars }}</strong>
        <span>GitHub stars</span>
      </a>
    {% endif %}
  </div>

{% include bib_search.liquid %}

{% bibliography %}

</div>
/*******************************************************************************
 * Design tokens — quiet, system-native interface
 *
 * Single source of truth for color, type, spacing, radius, shadow, motion.
 * Consumed by _themes.scss via CSS variables. Do NOT reference tokens directly
 * from component Sass — always go through CSS vars so dark mode works.
 ******************************************************************************/

// ------------ Color: Claude "Book Rust" scale (accent — current) ---------
// Light-mode primary = $rust-600 #B3654A (4.31:1 on pure white #FFFFFF).
// $rust-500 #CC785C is Claude's brand Book Rust, kept for decorative use.
// Dark-mode variant = $rust-light #E09B7F (7.2:1 AAA on warm dark).
$rust-50: #fbf1ec !default;
$rust-100: #f7e0d5 !default;
$rust-200: #efc3ae !default;
$rust-300: #e3a185 !default;
$rust-400: #d18766 !default;
$rust-500: #cc785c !default;
$rust-600: #b3654a !default;
$rust-700: #8c4a32 !default;
$rust-800: #5e301e !default;
$rust-900: #351810 !default;
$rust-light: #e09b7f !default; // dark-mode accent (AAA on warm dark)
$rust-light-hover: #f0b097 !default; // dark-mode hover

// Light neutrals (pure white surfaces; warm-dark tokens keep the dark theme)
$cream-bg: #ffffff !default;
$cream-subtle: #f5f5f7 !default;
$claude-ink: #1d1d1f !default;
$claude-ink-light: #6e6e73 !default;
$warm-dark-bg: #111113 !default;
$warm-dark-card: #1d1d1f !default;
$warm-dark-subtle: #242426 !default;
$warm-dark-text: #f5f5f7 !default;
$warm-dark-meta: #a1a1a6 !default;
// Slightly denser than the old 0.10 so it still reads on pure white.
$hairline-cream: rgba(29, 29, 31, 0.12) !default;
$hairline-warm-dark: rgba(245, 245, 247, 0.14) !default;

// ------------ Color: Oxford navy scale (DORMANT — previous accent) --------
// Light-mode primary = $navy-500 #1E3A5F (Oxford Blue, 10.6:1 AAA on warm off-white).
// Dark-mode brighter variant = $navy-light #7FA3D1 (7.5:1 AAA on cool-ink).
$navy-50: #f1f4f9 !default;
$navy-100: #dce3ee !default;
$navy-200: #b5c3d9 !default;
$navy-300: #8ea3c4 !default;
$navy-400: #6783af !default;
$navy-500: #1e3a5f !default;
$navy-600: #15274a !default;
$navy-700: #0f1c36 !default;
$navy-800: #091222 !default;
$navy-900: #05080f !default;
$navy-light: #7fa3d1 !default; // dark-mode accent
$navy-light-hover: #9cb8db !default; // dark-mode hover

// ------------ Color: teal scale (DORMANT — prior accent, kept for rollback)
$teal-50: #e6f0f1 !default;
$teal-100: #cde1e3 !default;
$teal-200: #9ec3c7 !default;
$teal-300: #6fa5ab !default;
$teal-400: #408790 !default;
$teal-500: #0f5257 !default;
$teal-600: #0b3f43 !default;
$teal-700: #082e31 !default;
$teal-800: #061f21 !default;
$teal-900: #031213 !default;
$teal-light: #4fc3c7 !default; // dark-mode accent
$teal-light-hover: #6fdce0 !default; // dark-mode hover

// ------------ Color: red scale (DORMANT — kept for legacy references) -----
// No live rule emits red as of 2026-04-19; scale retained so any stray
// references (e.g. .btn-outline-red class name) still resolve.
$red-50: #fff5f5 !default;
$red-100: #ffe5e5 !default;
$red-200: #fbc2c2 !default;
$red-300: #f28e8e !default;
$red-400: #e25a5a !default;
$red-500: #c5050c !default;
$red-600: #a10309 !default;
$red-700: #7d0207 !default;
$red-800: #5c0105 !default;
$red-900: #3d0003 !default;

// ------------ Color: neutrals (light, Tailwind-style) ---------------------
$n-0: #ffffff !default;
$n-50: #fafafa !default;
$n-100: #f3f4f6 !default;
$n-200: #e5e7eb !default;
$n-300: #d1d5db !default;
$n-400: #9ca3af !default;
$n-500: #6b7280 !default;
$n-600: #4b5563 !default;
$n-700: #374151 !default;
$n-800: #1f2937 !default;
$n-900: #111827 !default;

// ------------ Color: cool-ink (dark mode) --------------------------------
$ink-0: #0f1216 !default;
$ink-50: #151820 !default;
$ink-100: #1a1e26 !default;
$ink-200: #262b36 !default;
$ink-300: #363c48 !default;
$ink-400: #5b6271 !default;
$ink-500: #8a92a1 !default;
$ink-600: #adb4c0 !default;
$ink-700: #c9ced7 !default;
$ink-800: #dde0e6 !default;
$ink-900: #e8eaed !default;

// ------------ Typography families ----------------------------------------
$ff-sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "SF Pro Display", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;
$ff-serif: $ff-sans; // Compatibility alias for partials that still request display type.
$ff-mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace;

// ------------ Typography scale (rem) -------------------------------------
$fs-xs: 0.875rem; // mono eyebrow, small pills
$fs-sm: 0.875rem; // mono meta, news date, stat pills
$fs-base: 1.0625rem; // 17px body
$fs-md: 1.125rem; // publication title
$fs-lg: 1.375rem; // subsection heading
$fs-xl: 1.75rem; // h2
$fs-2xl: 2.25rem; // hero h1
$fs-3xl: 3.25rem; // display (reserved)

$lh-tight: 1.1;
$lh-snug: 1.25;
$lh-heading: 1.35;
$lh-body: 1.65;
$lh-relaxed: 1.7;

$fw-regular: 400;
$fw-medium: 500;
$fw-semibold: 600;
$fw-bold: 700;

$tracking-wide: 0.08em; // uppercase eyebrow / nav labels
$tracking-normal: 0;

// ------------ Spacing scale (px) -----------------------------------------
$sp-1: 4px;
$sp-2: 8px;
$sp-3: 12px;
$sp-4: 16px;
$sp-5: 24px;
$sp-6: 32px;
$sp-7: 48px;
$sp-8: 64px;
$sp-9: 96px;

// ------------ Radius -----------------------------------------------------
$r-sm: 8px; // inputs and compact controls
$r-md: 12px;
$r-lg: 16px; // cards and media
$r-pill: 999px;

// ------------ Shadow -----------------------------------------------------
$sh-none: none;
$sh-soft: 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06);
$sh-hover: 0 4px 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);

// ------------ Motion -----------------------------------------------------
$dur-fast: 120ms;
$dur-base: 200ms;
$dur-slow: 240ms;
$ease-out: cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1);

// ------------ Semantic ---------------------------------------------------
// Prefer reading these through CSS variables defined in _themes.scss.
// Kept here for Sass-only consumers (e.g. early partials).
$hairline-light: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06);
$hairline-dark: #1d2028;

// ------------ Warm neutrals (for Scheme 2: charcoal + deep teal) ----------
$warm-bg-light: #fafaf7; // warm off-white
$warm-subtle: #f0f0ec; // label bg, code bg
$charcoal: #1f2937; // body text (not pure black)
(() => {
  const selector = "[data-reveal]";
  const pendingClass = "reveal-pending";
  const visibleClass = "reveal-visible";
  const motionQuery = window.matchMedia ? window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)") : { matches: false };
  let observer;
  const heroState = window.homeHeroState;

  const finishHero = () => {
    if (!heroState) return;
    heroState.started = true;
    heroState.cleanup();
    document.documentElement.classList.remove("home-hero-prepared");
    document.documentElement.classList.remove("home-hero-started");
  };

  const startHero = () => {
    if (!heroState || heroState.started || document.visibilityState !== "visible") return;
    if (motionQuery.matches || heroState.expired) {
      finishHero();
      return;
    }
    heroState.started = true;
    heroState.cleanup();
    document.documentElement.classList.add("home-hero-started");
  };

  const reveal = (element) => {
    element.classList.remove(pendingClass);
    element.classList.add(visibleClass);
    if (observer) observer.unobserve(element);
  };

  const revealAll = () => {
    document.querySelectorAll(selector).forEach(reveal);
    if (observer) observer.disconnect();
    observer = undefined;
  };

  const init = () => {
    const elements = [...document.querySelectorAll(selector)];
    if (!elements.length || motionQuery.matches || !("IntersectionObserver" in window)) {
      revealAll();
      return;
    }

    observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => entries.forEach((entry) => entry.isIntersecting && reveal(entry.target)), {
      rootMargin: "0px 0px -8%",
      threshold: 0,
    });

    elements.forEach((element) => {
      const rect = element.getBoundingClientRect();
      if (rect.top < window.innerHeight && rect.bottom > 0) {
        reveal(element);
      } else {
        element.classList.add(pendingClass);
        observer.observe(element);
      }
    });
  };

  document.addEventListener("focusin", (event) => {
    const element = event.target.closest ? event.target.closest(selector) : null;
    if (element) reveal(element);
  });
  if (motionQuery.addEventListener) {
    motionQuery.addEventListener("change", (event) => {
      if (event.matches) {
        finishHero();
        revealAll();
      }
    });
  }

  window.addEventListener("pageshow", startHero);
  document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", startHero);
  if (document.visibilityState === "visible") {
    if (window.requestAnimationFrame) window.requestAnimationFrame(startHero);
    else startHero();
  }

  const safelyInit = () => {
    try {
      init();
    } catch (_) {
      revealAll();
    }
  };

  if (document.readyState === "loading") document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", safelyInit, { once: true });
  else safelyInit();
})();

"""
Fetch Google Scholar citation data and save to _data/scholar_citations.json.

Usage: python _scripts/fetch_scholar_citations.py
"""

import json
import os
import sys
from datetime import datetime, timezone

import yaml

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Config
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
SCRIPT_DIR = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
REPO_ROOT = os.path.dirname(SCRIPT_DIR)
CONFIG_PATH = os.path.join(REPO_ROOT, "_config.yml")
OUTPUT_PATH = os.path.join(REPO_ROOT, "_data", "scholar_citations.json")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def load_scholar_userid():
    with open(CONFIG_PATH, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        config = yaml.safe_load(f)
    uid = config.get("scholar_userid", "").strip()
    if not uid:
        print("ERROR: scholar_userid not found in _config.yml", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)
    return uid


def fetch_author(scholar_id: str):
    """Try direct fetch first; fall back to free proxies if blocked."""
    from scholarly import scholarly, ProxyGenerator

    # Attempt 1: direct connection
    try:
        print(f"Fetching Google Scholar profile for user: {scholar_id} (direct)...")
        author = scholarly.search_author_id(scholar_id)
        author = scholarly.fill(author, sections=["basics", "publications"])
        return author
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Direct fetch failed: {e}", file=sys.stderr)

    # Attempt 2: free proxies
    try:
        print("Retrying with free proxy...", file=sys.stderr)
        pg = ProxyGenerator()
        pg.FreeProxies()
        scholarly.use_proxy(pg)
        author = scholarly.search_author_id(scholar_id)
        author = scholarly.fill(author, sections=["basics", "publications"])
        return author
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Proxy fetch also failed: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
        return None


def build_output(author: dict, scholar_id: str) -> dict:
    total = author.get("citedby", 0)
    articles = {}

    for pub in author.get("publications", []):
        pub_id = pub.get("author_pub_id", "")
        # pub_id format: "userid:articleid"
        if ":" in pub_id:
            article_id = pub_id.split(":", 1)[1]
            citations = pub.get("num_citations", 0)
            articles[article_id] = citations

    return {
        "total_citations": total,
        "last_updated": datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%d"),
        "articles": articles,
    }


def load_existing() -> dict:
    if os.path.exists(OUTPUT_PATH):
        try:
            with open(OUTPUT_PATH, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                return json.load(f)
        except Exception:
            pass
    return {}


def save_output(data: dict):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(OUTPUT_PATH), exist_ok=True)
    with open(OUTPUT_PATH, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(data, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
        f.write("\n")
    print(f"Saved to {OUTPUT_PATH}")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Main
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def main():
    scholar_id = load_scholar_userid()
    author = fetch_author(scholar_id)

    if author is None:
        print(
            "ERROR: Could not fetch citation data. Keeping existing data unchanged.",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )
        if not os.path.exists(OUTPUT_PATH):
            # No existing data; write empty skeleton so Jekyll doesn't error
            save_output({
                "total_citations": 0,
                "last_updated": datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%d"),
                "articles": {},
            })
        sys.exit(1)

    data = build_output(author, scholar_id)
    print(f"Total citations: {data['total_citations']}")
    for aid, cnt in data["articles"].items():
        print(f"  {aid}: {cnt}")

    save_output(data)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
----
"""
Fetch GitHub star counts for repos referenced in papers.bib
and save to _data/github_stars.json.

Usage: python _scripts/fetch_github_stars.py
"""

import json
import os
import re
import sys
import urllib.request
import urllib.error
from datetime import datetime, timezone

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Config
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
SCRIPT_DIR = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
REPO_ROOT = os.path.dirname(SCRIPT_DIR)
BIB_PATH = os.path.join(REPO_ROOT, "_bibliography", "papers.bib")
OUTPUT_PATH = os.path.join(REPO_ROOT, "_data", "github_stars.json")

GITHUB_API = "https://api.github.com/repos/{}"
TOKEN = os.environ.get("GITHUB_TOKEN", "")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def extract_github_repos(bib_path: str) -> list[str]:
    """Extract all github_repo values from a .bib file."""
    pattern = re.compile(r"github_repo\s*=\s*\{([^}]+)\}")
    repos = []
    with open(bib_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        for match in pattern.finditer(f.read()):
            repo = match.group(1).strip()
            if repo and repo not in repos:
                repos.append(repo)
    return repos


def fetch_stars(repo: str) -> int | None:
    """Fetch stargazers_count for a single repo via GitHub REST API."""
    url = GITHUB_API.format(repo)
    headers = {
        "Accept": "application/vnd.github+json",
        "User-Agent": "github-stars-fetcher",
    }
    if TOKEN:
        headers["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {TOKEN}"

    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers=headers)
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=15) as resp:
            data = json.loads(resp.read().decode())
            return data.get("stargazers_count", 0)
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        print(f"  HTTP {e.code} for {repo}: {e.reason}", file=sys.stderr)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"  Error fetching {repo}: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
    return None


def load_existing() -> dict:
    if os.path.exists(OUTPUT_PATH):
        try:
            with open(OUTPUT_PATH, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                return json.load(f)
        except Exception:
            pass
    return {}


def save_output(data: dict):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(OUTPUT_PATH), exist_ok=True)
    with open(OUTPUT_PATH, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(data, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
        f.write("\n")
    print(f"Saved to {OUTPUT_PATH}")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Main
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def main():
    if not os.path.exists(BIB_PATH):
        print(f"ERROR: {BIB_PATH} not found", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)

    repos = extract_github_repos(BIB_PATH)
    if not repos:
        print("No github_repo entries found in papers.bib")
        save_output({
            "total_stars": 0,
            "last_updated": datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%d"),
            "repos": {},
        })
        return

    print(f"Found {len(repos)} repo(s) in papers.bib")
    existing = load_existing()
    existing_repos = existing.get("repos", {})

    result_repos: dict[str, int] = {}
    any_failure = False

    for repo in repos:
        print(f"  Fetching stars for {repo}...")
        stars = fetch_stars(repo)
        if stars is not None:
            result_repos[repo] = stars
            print(f"    -> {stars} stars")
        else:
            any_failure = True
            fallback = existing_repos.get(repo, 0)
            result_repos[repo] = fallback
            print(f"    -> fetch failed, using cached value: {fallback}")

    total = sum(result_repos.values())
    data = {
        "total_stars": total,
        "last_updated": datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%d"),
        "repos": result_repos,
    }

    print(f"Total stars: {total}")
    save_output(data)

    if any_failure:
        print("WARNING: Some repos failed to fetch. Cached values used.", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

name: Update Scholar Citations

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 4 * * 1" # Every Monday at 4:00 AM UTC
  workflow_dispatch: # Allow manual trigger

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  update-citations:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: "3.13"
          cache: "pip"

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pip install -r _scripts/requirements.txt

      - name: Fetch citation data
        id: fetch
        continue-on-error: true
        run: python _scripts/fetch_scholar_citations.py

      - name: Check for changes
        id: check
        run: |
          if git diff --quiet _data/scholar_citations.json 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "changed=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "changed=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Commit and push
        if: steps.check.outputs.changed == 'true'
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add _data/scholar_citations.json
          git commit -m "Update Google Scholar citations data"
          git push
name: Update GitHub Stars

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 4 * * 1" # Every Monday at 4:00 AM UTC
  workflow_dispatch: # Allow manual trigger

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  update-stars:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: "3.13"

      - name: Fetch GitHub stars data
        id: fetch
        continue-on-error: true
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: python _scripts/fetch_github_stars.py

      - name: Check for changes
        id: check
        run: |
          if git diff --quiet _data/github_stars.json 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "changed=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "changed=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Commit and push
        if: steps.check.outputs.changed == 'true'
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add _data/github_stars.json
          git commit -m "Update GitHub stars data"
          git push

// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Publications — quiet editorial rows, no interface chrome.
//
// Layout: year headers act as sticky gutter labels on desktop (≥992px) and
// inline headers on mobile. Each paper is a hairline row — no boxed card.
// Venue reads as small accent-colored letters above the thumbnail, links as
// pill buttons (filled primary "Paper"), counts as neutral metric pills.
// ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

.publications {
  margin-top: $sp-4;

  h1 {
    color: var(--global-text-color);
    font-family: $ff-serif;
    font-size: $fs-2xl;
    font-weight: $fw-medium;
    text-align: left;
    margin: $sp-6 0 $sp-4;
  }

  // Scholar / GitHub totals — prominent large figures above search.
  .pub-stats {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: $sp-6;
    font-family: $ff-sans;
    color: var(--global-text-color-light);
    margin: 0 0 $sp-7;

    a {
      display: grid;
      gap: $sp-1;
      min-width: 144px;
      color: var(--global-text-color);
      text-decoration: none;

      strong {
        font-size: 40px;
        font-weight: $fw-semibold;
        line-height: 1;
        letter-spacing: -0.035em;
      }

      span {
        font-size: 14px;
        color: var(--global-text-color-light);
      }

      &:hover {
        color: var(--global-theme-color);
      }
    }
  }

  // Year group header (jekyll-scholar emits <h2 class="bibliography">YEAR</h2>).
  h2.bibliography {
    font-family: $ff-sans;
    font-size: $fs-sm;
    font-weight: $fw-semibold;
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
    color: var(--mono-meta-color);
    text-align: left;
    border: 0;
    padding-top: 0;
    margin: $sp-6 0 $sp-3;
  }

  @media (min-width: 992px) {
    h2.bibliography {
      position: sticky;
      top: 64px; // navbar height (body.fixed-top-nav padding-top in _layout.scss)
      background: var(--global-bg-color);
      z-index: 2;
    }
  }

  ol.bibliography {
    list-style: none;
    padding: 0;
    margin-top: 0;

    > li {
      position: relative;
      padding: $sp-6 0;

      .publication-row {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
        gap: $sp-6;
        margin: 0;
      }

      .publication-row--with-media {
        grid-template-columns: 320px minmax(0, 1fr);
      }

      .pub-media,
      .pub-content {
        min-width: 0;
      }

      // Thumbnails keep their natural aspect ratio — no frame, no matte.
      .pub-media figure {
        margin: 0;
      }

      .preview {
        width: 100%;
        height: auto;
        border-radius: $r-md;
        box-shadow: none;
      }

      .preview img {
        width: 100%;
        height: auto;
        border-radius: $r-md;
        box-shadow: none;
      }

      // Venue tags read as accent-colored letters only — no box, no fill.
      .abbr {
        margin-bottom: $sp-2;

        abbr {
          display: inline-block;

91	  if (document.readyState === "loading") document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", safelyInit, { once: true });
92	  else safelyInit();

9	function eventTarget() {
10	  const listeners = {};
11	  return {
12	    addEventListener(type, listener) {
13	      (listeners[type] || (listeners[type] = [])).push(listener);
14	    },
15	    removeEventListener(type, listener) {
16	      listeners[type] = (listeners[type] || []).filter((item) => item !== listener);
17	    },
18	    dispatch(type, event = {}) {
19	      (listeners[type] || []).slice().forEach((listener) => listener(event));
20	    },
21	  };
22	}
23	
24	function environment({ reduced = false, visibility = "visible" } = {}) {
25	  const classes = new Set();
26	  const documentEvents = eventTarget();
27	  const windowEvents = eventTarget();
28	  const motionEvents = eventTarget();
29	  const timers = [];
30	  const frames = [];
31	  const motionQuery = Object.assign(motionEvents, { matches: reduced });
32	  const document = Object.assign(documentEvents, {
33	    documentElement: {
34	      classList: {
35	        add: (...names) => names.forEach((name) => classes.add(name)),
36	        contains: (name) => classes.has(name),
37	        remove: (...names) => names.forEach((name) => classes.delete(name)),
38	      },
39	    },
40	    querySelectorAll: () => [],
41	    readyState: "complete",
42	    visibilityState: visibility,
43	  });
44	  const window = Object.assign(windowEvents, {
45	    clearTimeout: (timer) => {
46	      timer.cleared = true;
47	    },
48	    innerHeight: 800,
49	    matchMedia: () => motionQuery,
50	    requestAnimationFrame: (callback) => frames.push(callback),
51	    setTimeout: (callback) => {
52	      const timer = { callback, cleared: false };
53	      timers.push(timer);
54	      return timer;
55	    },
56	  });
57	  const context = vm.createContext({ document, window });
58	  return { classes, context, document, frames, motionQuery, timers, window };
59	}

{% assign img_path = include.path | remove: '.jpg' | remove: '.jpeg' | remove: '.png' | remove: '.tiff' | remove: '.gif' %}
{% assign parts = include.path | split: '.' %}
{% assign ext = parts.last %}

<figure
  {% if include.slot %}
    slot="{{ include.slot }}"
  {% endif %}
>
  <picture>
    {% if include.reduced_motion_path %}
      <source media="(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)" srcset="{{ include.reduced_motion_path | relative_url }}">
    {% endif %}
    <!-- Auto scaling with imagemagick -->
    <!--
      See https://www.debugbear.com/blog/responsive-images#w-descriptors-and-the-sizes-attribute and
      https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Learn/HTML/Multimedia_and_embedding/Responsive_images for info on defining 'sizes' for responsive images
    -->
    {% if site.imagemagick.enabled %}
      <source
        class="responsive-img-srcset"
        {% if ext == 'gif' or ext == 'jpeg' or ext == 'jpg' or ext == 'png' or ext == 'tiff' %}
          srcset="{% for i in site.imagemagick.widths %}{{ img_path | relative_url }}-{{ i }}.webp {{ i }}w,{% endfor %}"
          type="image/webp"
        {% else %}
          srcset="{{ include.path | relative_url }}"
        {% endif %}
        {% if include.sizes %}
          sizes="{{ include.sizes }}"
        {% else %}
          sizes="95vw"
        {% endif %}
      >
    {% endif %}
    <img
      src="{% if include.url %}{{ include.url }}{% elsif include.cache_bust %}{{ include.path | relative_url | bust_file_cache }}{% else %}{{ include.path | relative_url }}{% endif %}"
      {% if include.class %}
        class="{{ include.class }}"
      {% endif %}
      {% if include.width %}
        width="{{ include.width }}"
      {% endif %}
      {% if include.height %}

I work on autonomous driving and human-centered intelligent transportation through simulation, real-vehicle testing, and human-AI collaboration.     def _fill_counts(self, soup, author):
        years = [int(y.text)
                 for y in soup.find_all('span', class_='gsc_g_t')]

        cites = [0]*len(years)
        for c in soup.find_all('a', class_='gsc_g_a'):
            i = int(c['style'].split(':')[-1])
            cites[-i] = int(c.find('span', class_='gsc_g_al').text)

        author['cites_per_year'] = dict(zip(years, cites))

    def _fill_public_access(self, soup, author):
        available = soup.find('div', class_='gsc_rsb_m_a')
        not_available = soup.find('div', class_='gsc_rsb_m_na')
        n_available, n_not_available = 0, 0
        if available:
            n_available = int(re.sub("[.,]", "", available.text.split(" ")[0]))
        if not_available:
            n_not_available = int(re.sub("[.,]", "", not_available.text.split(" ")[0]))

        author["public_access"] = PublicAccess(available=n_available,

(() => {
  try {
    const motionQuery = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)");
    if (motionQuery && motionQuery.matches) return;

    const root = document.documentElement;
    let timer;
    let state;

    const cleanup = () => {
      if (timer) window.clearTimeout(timer);
      document.removeEventListener("visibilitychange", monitorVisibility);
    };

    const failOpen = () => {
      state.expired = true;
      cleanup();
      root.classList.remove("home-hero-prepared");
    };

    const monitorVisibility = () => {
      if (timer) window.clearTimeout(timer);
      if (document.visibilityState === "visible") timer = window.setTimeout(failOpen, 2000);
    };

    root.classList.add("home-hero-prepared");
    state = { cleanup, expired: false, started: false };
    document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", monitorVisibility);
    monitorVisibility();
    window.homeHeroState = state;
  } catch (_) {
    document.documentElement.classList.remove("home-hero-prepared");
  }
})();

// Publications page growth cards: draws cumulative citation / GitHub star
// curves from the #growth-data JSON emitted by _pages/publications.md.
(() => {
  const SVG_NS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";
  const NO_CHART_CLASS = "growth-card--no-chart";
  const DAY_MS = 86400000;
  const VIEW_W = 100;
  const VIEW_H = 40;
  const PAD_TOP = 3;
  const PAD_BOTTOM = 1;
  const MONTHS = ["Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun", "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec"];
  const STOPS = [
    ["0", "var(--ai-c1, #0894ff)"],
    ["0.34", "var(--ai-c2, #c959dd)"],
    ["0.67", "var(--ai-c3, #ff2e54)"],
    ["1", "var(--ai-c4, #ff9004)"],
  ];

  // --- Pure helpers: series + geometry (no DOM) ---------------------------

  const toNumber = (value) => (value === null || value === undefined || value === "" ? NaN : Number(value));

  const parseDay = (value) => {
    const match = /^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})/.exec(String(value || ""));
    return match ? Date.UTC(Number(match[1]), Number(match[2]) - 1, Number(match[3])) : NaN;
  };

  const todayUtc = (now) => Date.UTC(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate());

  const monthLabel = (time) => {
    const date = new Date(time);
    return `${MONTHS[date.getUTCMonth()]} ${date.getUTCFullYear()}`;
  };

  // Sort by time, drop invalid points, merge same-day points (later one wins).
  const normalize = (points) => {
    const merged = [];
    points
      .filter((point) => Number.isFinite(point.t) && Number.isFinite(point.v))
      .sort((a, b) => a.t - b.t)
      .forEach((point) => {
        const last = merged[merged.length - 1];
        if (last && point.t <= last.t) last.v = point.v;
        else merged.push({ t: point.t, v: point.v });
      });
    return merged;
  };

  // Per-year (non-cumulative) Scholar counts -> cumulative curve from Jan 1 of
  // the first year to today. A larger reported total (Scholar lag) wins at the end.
  const citationSeries = (perYear, total, today) => {
    if (!perYear || typeof perYear !== "object" || Array.isArray(perYear)) return null;
    const years = Object.keys(perYear)
      .map(Number)
      .filter((year) => Number.isInteger(year) && year > 1900);
    if (!years.length) return null;
    const first = Math.min(...years);
    const currentYear = new Date(today).getUTCFullYear();
    const last = Math.max(Math.max(...years), currentYear);
    const points = [{ t: Date.UTC(first, 0, 1), v: 0 }];
    let sum = 0;
    for (let year = first; year <= last; year += 1) {
      const count = toNumber(perYear[year]);
      sum += Number.isFinite(count) && count > 0 ? count : 0;
      points.push({ t: year >= currentYear ? today : Date.UTC(year, 11, 31), v: sum });
    }
    const series = normalize(points);
    if (series.length < 2) return null;
    const end = series[series.length - 1];
    const reported = toNumber(total);
    if (Number.isFinite(reported) && reported > end.v) end.v = reported;
    return { points: series, start: String(first), end: String(new Date(end.t).getUTCFullYear()) };
  };

  // Dated cumulative star totals -> curve starting at 0 the day before the
  // first record and ending today at the reported total.
  const starSeries = (history, total, today) => {
    if (!Array.isArray(history)) return null;
    const rows = normalize(history.map((row) => ({ t: parseDay(row && row.date), v: toNumber(row && row.stars) })));
    if (!rows.length) return null;
    const lastRow = rows[rows.length - 1];
    const reported = toNumber(total);
    const points = normalize([
      { t: rows[0].t - DAY_MS, v: 0 },
      ...rows,
      { t: Math.max(today, lastRow.t), v: Number.isFinite(reported) ? reported : lastRow.v },
    ]);
    if (points.length < 2) return null;
    return { points, start: monthLabel(rows[0].t), end: monthLabel(points[points.length - 1].t) };
  };

  // Map {t, v} into the 100x40 viewBox; y runs from 0 (bottom) to the max value.
  const project = (points) => {
    const t0 = points[0].t;
    const span = points[points.length - 1].t - t0 || 1;
    const max = Math.max(1, ...points.map((point) => point.v));
    const height = VIEW_H - PAD_TOP - PAD_BOTTOM;
    return points.map((point) => ({
      x: ((point.t - t0) / span) * VIEW_W,
      y: VIEW_H - PAD_BOTTOM - (Math.max(0, point.v) / max) * height,
    }));
  };

  const fmt = (value) => String(Math.round(value * 1000) / 1000);

  // Monotone cubic interpolation (Fritsch–Carlson): smooth, never overshoots.
  const monotonePath = (pts) => {
    const n = pts.length;
    if (n < 2) return "";
    const h = [];
    const d = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < n - 1; i += 1) {
      h[i] = pts[i + 1].x - pts[i].x;
      d[i] = h[i] > 0 ? (pts[i + 1].y - pts[i].y) / h[i] : 0;
    }
    const m = new Array(n);
    m[0] = d[0];
    m[n - 1] = d[n - 2];
    for (let i = 1; i < n - 1; i += 1) m[i] = d[i - 1] * d[i] <= 0 ? 0 : (d[i - 1] + d[i]) / 2;
    for (let i = 0; i < n - 1; i += 1) {
      if (d[i] === 0) {
        m[i] = 0;
        m[i + 1] = 0;
      } else {
        const a = m[i] / d[i];
        const b = m[i + 1] / d[i];
        const s = a * a + b * b;
        if (s > 9) {
          const tau = 3 / Math.sqrt(s);
          m[i] = tau * a * d[i];
          m[i + 1] = tau * b * d[i];
        }
      }
    }
    let path = `M${fmt(pts[0].x)},${fmt(pts[0].y)}`;
    for (let i = 0; i < n - 1; i += 1) {
      const third = h[i] / 3;
      path +=
        `C${fmt(pts[i].x + third)},${fmt(pts[i].y + m[i] * third)} ` +
        `${fmt(pts[i + 1].x - third)},${fmt(pts[i + 1].y - m[i + 1] * third)} ` +
        `${fmt(pts[i + 1].x)},${fmt(pts[i + 1].y)}`;
    }
    return path;
  };

  // --- DOM ------------------------------------------------------------------

  const svgEl = (name, attrs) => {
    const element = document.createElementNS(SVG_NS, name);
    Object.keys(attrs).forEach((key) => element.setAttribute(key, String(attrs[key])));
    return element;
  };

  const render = (svg, series, id) => {
    const pts = project(series.points);
    const line = monotonePath(pts);
    const area = `${line}L${fmt(pts[pts.length - 1].x)},${VIEW_H}L${fmt(pts[0].x)},${VIEW_H}Z`;

    const stroke = svgEl("linearGradient", { id: `${id}-stroke`, gradientUnits: "userSpaceOnUse", x1: 0, y1: 0, x2: VIEW_W, y2: 0 });
    STOPS.forEach(([offset, color]) => stroke.appendChild(svgEl("stop", { offset, style: `stop-color: ${color}` })));
    const fade = svgEl("linearGradient", { id: `${id}-fade`, gradientUnits: "userSpaceOnUse", x1: 0, y1: PAD_TOP, x2: 0, y2: VIEW_H });
    fade.appendChild(svgEl("stop", { offset: 0, "stop-color": "#fff", "stop-opacity": 0.26 }));
    fade.appendChild(svgEl("stop", { offset: 1, "stop-color": "#fff", "stop-opacity": 0 }));
    const mask = svgEl("mask", { id: `${id}-mask`, maskUnits: "userSpaceOnUse", x: 0, y: 0, width: VIEW_W, height: VIEW_H });
    mask.appendChild(svgEl("rect", { x: 0, y: 0, width: VIEW_W, height: VIEW_H, fill: `url(#${id}-fade)` }));
    const defs = svgEl("defs", {});
    defs.appendChild(stroke);
    defs.appendChild(fade);
    defs.appendChild(mask);

    svg.setAttribute("viewBox", `0 0 ${VIEW_W} ${VIEW_H}`);
    svg.setAttribute("preserveAspectRatio", "none");
    svg.setAttribute("focusable", "false");
    svg.appendChild(defs);
    svg.appendChild(svgEl("path", { d: area, fill: `url(#${id}-stroke)`, mask: `url(#${id}-mask)` }));
    svg.appendChild(
      svgEl("path", {
        d: line,
        fill: "none",
        stroke: `url(#${id}-stroke)`,
        "stroke-width": 2.5,
        "stroke-linecap": "round",
        "stroke-linejoin": "round",
        "vector-effect": "non-scaling-stroke",
      })
    );
  };

  const readData = () => {
    const source = document.getElementById("growth-data");
    try {
      return (source && JSON.parse(source.textContent)) || {};
    } catch (_) {
      return {};
    }
  };

  const init = () => {
    const charts = document.querySelectorAll(".growth-card__chart[data-series]");
    if (!charts.length) return;
    const data = readData();
    const today = todayUtc(new Date());
    const builders = {
      citations: () => citationSeries(data.citations, data.citationsTotal, today),
      stars: () => starSeries(data.stars, data.starsTotal, today),
    };

    Array.prototype.forEach.call(charts, (svg, index) => {
      const name = svg.getAttribute("data-series");
      const card = (svg.closest && svg.closest(".growth-card")) || svg.parentNode;
      try {
        const series = builders[name] ? builders[name]() : null;
        if (!series || series.points.length < 2) throw new Error("growth-charts: not enough data");
        render(svg, series, `growth-${name}-${index}`);
        const labels = card.querySelectorAll(".growth-card__axis span");
        if (labels.length >= 2) {
          labels[0].textContent = series.start;
          labels[labels.length - 1].textContent = series.end;
        }
      } catch (_) {
        while (svg.firstChild) svg.removeChild(svg.firstChild);
        if (card && card.classList) card.classList.add(NO_CHART_CLASS);
      }
    });
  };

  const safelyInit = () => {
    try {
      init();
    } catch (_) {
      // Charts are decorative; the totals stay readable without them.
    }
  };

  if (document.readyState === "loading") document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", safelyInit, { once: true });
  else safelyInit();
})();

assert.strictEqual(h.citationSeries([1, 2], 23, today), null);

assert.deepStrictEqual(s.points.map((p) => p.v), [0, 1, 3, 9, 9]);
assert.strictEqual(day(s.points[0].t), "2025-03-01");

// history ending today, total null -> last stars used, no duplicate point

  const segs = d.split("C").slice(1).map((seg) => seg.trim().split(/[ ,]+/).map(Number));
  let prev = [pts[0].x, pts[0].y];
  let prevY = Infinity;
  segs.forEach((s) => {
    const [x1, y1, x2, y2, x3, y3] = s;
    const [x0, y0] = prev;
    for (let t = 0; t <= 1; t += 0.01) {

      assert.ok(x >= x0 - 1e-6 && x <= x3 + 1e-6, "x out of segment");
      prevY = y;
    }
    prev = [x3, y3];
  });

EOF

}

.home-hero-started .about-home .about-hero__media {
  animation: home-hero-enter 1100ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1) 200ms both;
}

@keyframes home-hero-enter {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(8px);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: none;
  }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .home-hero-prepared .about-home .about-hero__header,
  .home-hero-prepared .about-home .about-hero__bio,
  .home-hero-prepared .about-home .about-hero__media,
  .about-home .about-hero__header,
  .about-home .about-hero__bio,
  .about-home .about-hero__media {
    animation: none;
    opacity: 1;
    transform: none;
  }
}
@media (forced-colors: active) {
  .post-header .post-title.gradient-title,
  .post-header .post-title.gradient-title span,
  .about-subtitle,
  .about-subtitle span,
  .home-section > .home-section__title {
    color: CanvasText;
    background: none;
    -webkit-text-fill-color: CanvasText;
  }
  html .home-section > .home-section__title a,
  .about-home .about-social .contact-icons a:hover i::before,
  .about-home .about-social .contact-icons a:focus-visible i::before {
    color: LinkText;
    background: none;
    -webkit-text-fill-color: LinkText;
  }
  html .publications ol.bibliography > li .abbr abbr,
  html .publications ol.bibliography > li .abbr abbr.venue--strong,
  html .publications ol.bibliography > li .abbr abbr a,
  html .publications ol.bibliography > li .abbr abbr div {
    color: CanvasText !important;
    background: none !important;
    border-color: CanvasText;
    -webkit-text-fill-color: CanvasText;
  }
}
@media print {
  .post-header .post-title.gradient-title,
  .post-header .post-title.gradient-title span,
  .about-subtitle,
  .about-subtitle span,
  .home-section > .home-section__title,
  .home-section > .home-section__title a {
    color: #1d1d1f !important;
    background: none !important;
    -webkit-text-fill-color: #1d1d1f !important;
  }
  html .publications ol.bibliography > li .abbr abbr,
  html .publications ol.bibliography > li .abbr abbr.venue--strong,
  html .publications ol.bibliography > li .abbr abbr a,
  html .publications ol.bibliography > li .abbr abbr div {
    color: #1d1d1f !important;
    background: none !important;
    border-color: #6e6e73 !important;
    -webkit-text-fill-color: #1d1d1f !important;
  }
  .about-home .about-hero__header,
  .about-home .about-hero__bio,
  .about-home .about-hero__media,
  .home-hero-prepared .about-home .about-hero__header,
  .home-hero-prepared .about-home .about-hero__bio,
  .home-hero-prepared .about-home .about-hero__media {
    animation: none !important;
    opacity: 1 !important;
    transform: none !important;
  }
}
.profile img {
  width: 100%;
  height: auto;

```text
name: Update GitHub Stars

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 4 * * 1" # Every Monday at 4:00 AM UTC
  workflow_dispatch: # Allow manual trigger

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  update-stars:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: "3.13"

      - name: Fetch GitHub stars data
        id: fetch
        continue-on-error: true
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: python _scripts/fetch_github_stars.py

      - name: Check for changes
        id: check
        run: |
          if git diff --quiet _data/github_stars.json 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "changed=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "changed=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Commit and push
        if: steps.check.outputs.changed == 'true'
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add _data/github_stars.json
          git commit -m "Update GitHub stars data"
          git push
```

1	"""
2	Fetch GitHub star counts for repos referenced in papers.bib
3	and save to _data/github_stars.json.
4	
5	Usage: python _scripts/fetch_github_stars.py
6	"""
7	
8	import json
9	import os
10	import re
11	import sys
12	import urllib.request
13	import urllib.error
14	from collections import Counter
15	from datetime import datetime, timezone
16	
17	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
18	# Config
19	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
20	SCRIPT_DIR = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
21	REPO_ROOT = os.path.dirname(SCRIPT_DIR)
22	BIB_PATH = os.path.join(REPO_ROOT, "_bibliography", "papers.bib")
23	OUTPUT_PATH = os.path.join(REPO_ROOT, "_data", "github_stars.json")
24	
25	GITHUB_API = "https://api.github.com/repos/{}"
26	STARGAZERS_API = "https://api.github.com/repos/{}/stargazers?per_page=100&page={}"
27	TOKEN = os.environ.get("GITHUB_TOKEN", "")
28	
29	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
30	# Helpers
31	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
32	
33	def extract_github_repos(bib_path: str) -> list[str]:
34	    """Extract all github_repo values from a .bib file."""
35	    pattern = re.compile(r"github_repo\s*=\s*\{([^}]+)\}")
36	    repos = []
37	    with open(bib_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
38	        for match in pattern.finditer(f.read()):
39	            repo = match.group(1).strip()
40	            if repo and repo not in repos:
41	                repos.append(repo)
42	    return repos
43	
44	
45	def fetch_stars(repo: str) -> int | None:
46	    """Fetch stargazers_count for a single repo via GitHub REST API."""
47	    url = GITHUB_API.format(repo)
48	    headers = {
49	        "Accept": "application/vnd.github+json",
50	        "User-Agent": "github-stars-fetcher",
51	    }
52	    if TOKEN:
53	        headers["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {TOKEN}"
54	
55	    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers=headers)
56	    try:
57	        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=15) as resp:
58	            data = json.loads(resp.read().decode())
59	            return data.get("stargazers_count", 0)
60	    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
61	        print(f"  HTTP {e.code} for {repo}: {e.reason}", file=sys.stderr)
62	    except Exception as e:
63	        print(f"  Error fetching {repo}: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
64	    return None
65	
66	
67	def fetch_star_dates(repo: str) -> list[str] | None:
68	    """Fetch the starred_at date (YYYY-MM-DD, UTC) of every stargazer of a repo."""
69	    headers = {
70	        "Accept": "application/vnd.github.star+json",
71	        "User-Agent": "github-stars-fetcher",
72	    }
73	    if TOKEN:
74	        headers["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {TOKEN}"
75	
76	    dates = []
77	    page = 1
78	    while True:
79	        req = urllib.request.Request(STARGAZERS_API.format(repo, page), headers=headers)
80	        try:
81	            with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=15) as resp:
82	                items = json.loads(resp.read().decode())
83	        except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
84	            print(f"  HTTP {e.code} for {repo} stargazers: {e.reason}", file=sys.stderr)
85	            return None
86	        except Exception as e:
87	            print(f"  Error fetching {repo} stargazers: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
88	            return None
89	        if not items:
90	            break
91	        for item in items:
92	            starred_at = item.get("starred_at")
93	            if starred_at:
94	                dates.append(starred_at[:10])
95	        page += 1
96	    return dates
97	
98	
99	def build_history(dates: list[str]) -> list[dict]:
100	    """Cumulative star total after each calendar day on which stars were added."""
101	    history = []
102	    running = 0
103	    for day, count in sorted(Counter(dates).items()):
104	        running += count
105	        history.append({"date": day, "stars": running})
106	    return history
107	
108	
109	def load_existing() -> dict:
110	    if os.path.exists(OUTPUT_PATH):
111	        try:
112	            with open(OUTPUT_PATH, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
113	                return json.load(f)
114	        except Exception:
115	            pass
116	    return {}
117	
118	
119	def save_output(data: dict):
120	    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(OUTPUT_PATH), exist_ok=True)
121	    with open(OUTPUT_PATH, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
122	        json.dump(data, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
123	        f.write("\n")
124	    print(f"Saved to {OUTPUT_PATH}")
125	
126	
127	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
128	# Main
129	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
130	
131	def main():
132	    if not os.path.exists(BIB_PATH):
133	        print(f"ERROR: {BIB_PATH} not found", file=sys.stderr)
134	        sys.exit(1)
135	
136	    repos = extract_github_repos(BIB_PATH)
137	    if not repos:
138	        print("No github_repo entries found in papers.bib")
139	        save_output({
140	            "total_stars": 0,
141	            "last_updated": datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%d"),
142	            "repos": {},
143	            "history": [],
144	        })
145	        return
146	
147	    print(f"Found {len(repos)} repo(s) in papers.bib")
148	    existing = load_existing()
149	    existing_repos = existing.get("repos", {})
150	
151	    result_repos: dict[str, int] = {}
152	    star_dates: list[str] = []
153	    history_failure = False
154	    any_failure = False
155	
156	    for repo in repos:
157	        print(f"  Fetching stars for {repo}...")
158	        stars = fetch_stars(repo)
159	        if stars is not None:
160	            result_repos[repo] = stars
161	            print(f"    -> {stars} stars")
162	        else:
163	            any_failure = True
164	            fallback = existing_repos.get(repo, 0)
165	            result_repos[repo] = fallback
166	            print(f"    -> fetch failed, using cached value: {fallback}")
167	
168	        print(f"  Fetching star history for {repo}...")
169	        dates = fetch_star_dates(repo)
170	        if dates is not None:
171	            star_dates.extend(dates)
172	            print(f"    -> {len(dates)} timestamped stars")
173	        else:
174	            history_failure = True
175	            any_failure = True
176	            print("    -> fetch failed, will keep cached history")
177	
178	    if history_failure:
179	        history = existing.get("history", [])
180	    else:
181	        history = build_history(star_dates)
182	
183	    total = sum(result_repos.values())
184	    data = {
185	        "total_stars": total,
186	        "last_updated": datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%d"),
187	        "repos": result_repos,
188	        "history": history,
189	    }
190	
191	    print(f"Total stars: {total}")
192	    save_output(data)
193

196	        sys.exit(1)
197

    for name in owned_by_lower.values():
        if owned[name] > 0:
            result_repos[name] = owned[name]
            print(f"  {name}: {owned[name]} stars")

    for repo, count in result_repos.items():
        if count < 1:
            continue
        print(f"  Fetching star history for {repo}...")
        dates = fetch_star_dates(repo)
        if dates is not None:
            star_dates.extend(dates)
            print(f"    -> {len(dates)} timestamped stars")
        else:
            history_failure = True
            any_failure = True
            print("    -> fetch failed, will keep cached history")

    if history_failure:
        history = existing.get("history", [])
    else:
        history = build_history(star_dates)

    total = sum(result_repos.values())
    data = {
        "total_stars": total,
        "last_updated": datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%d"),
        "repos": result_repos,
        "history": history,
    }

    print(f"Total stars: {total}")
    save_output(data)

    if any_failure:
        print("WARNING: Some repos failed to fetch. Cached values/history used.", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

+def read_github_username(config_path: str) -> str | None:

+                items = json.loads(resp.read().decode())

+            return None
+        if not items:

+        for item in items:
+            if not item.get("fork"):
+                repos[item["full_name"]] = item.get("stargazers_count", 0)
+        page += 1
+    return repos

_**Agent (claude-opus-5-5 2026-09-26 06:26:13Z)**_

Found the root cause, and it's a GitHub policy change, not our code. Since July 2026, listing stargazers (with star dates) only works for a repo's **admins and collaborators**. Your token is being used now, but it was created with "Public repositories" access. That mode doesn't count as having admin access to your repos, so GitHub returns `Resource not accessible by personal access token`.

**Fix: edit the existing token.** The token value doesn't change, so `STARS_TOKEN` stays valid.
1. Open https://github.com/settings/personal-access-tokens, click your `site-star-history` token, then **Edit**.
2. Change **Repository access** to **All repositories**. That covers only repos you own, and you're the admin of those.
3. Don't add any permissions. The read-only Metadata permission is added automatically.
4. Click **Update**, then tell me. I'll run the workflow again.

If it still returns 403, the next step is to add **Administration: Read-only**, which is still read-only.

**On the Scholar update that stopped after Aug 31:** the fix is pushed but hasn't been tested in GitHub Actions yet.
- **Cause:** bibtexparser 2.0 came out on Sep 8, and the Google Scholar library the script uses (`scholarly`) can't import it. The fetch step has `continue-on-error`, so every weekly run showed green while committing nothing.
- **Fix:** `_scripts/requirements.txt` now pins `bibtexparser<2`, pushed in `f56b4561`. The data is also current: I refreshed it locally today (citations 23 → 25), and that went live.
- **Not yet verified:** the last Scholar run was Sep 21, before the fix. The next scheduled run is Monday (Sep 28).

Should I also run "Update Scholar Citations" once now, after we retry the stars, to confirm the fix works in CI?

The stars and Scholar workflows both show green even when a step fails, which is how both problems went unnoticed. I can change them so a failed data fetch turns the run red while still keeping the cached data.

**GitHub 现在要求 token 对仓库有 Contents: Read and write（写权限）才能读取 star 的日期。这个 token 加密存在仓库 secret 里，只有你仓库的 workflow 能用，fork 来的 PR 拿不到；但万一泄露，就能改它有权限的仓库。怎么选？**

Options:
- **写权限，限 5 个有 star 的仓库 (推荐)** - token 改为 Only select repositories：Sky-Drive、BillWan-zzzyyy.github.io、Implied-volatility_Skewness、RampAvaiability、website-old，权限加 Contents: Read and write。曲线是完整的真实 star 日期。以后哪个新仓库有了 star，需要手动加进 token（漏加的仅曲线缺这几颗，总数仍准确）
- **写权限，所有仓库** - 保持 All repositories，权限加 Contents: Read and write。省心、自动覆盖新仓库，但泄露时影响面最大
- **不给写权限，改记快照** - 删掉 token。脚本每周记录一次总数，曲线从今天的 13 开始慢慢长出来，之前的历史没有。最安全，但短期内几乎是一条平线


**Answer:** 不给写权限，改记快照
</details></tool-use>

1	"""
2	Fetch GitHub star counts for every non-fork repo owned by the site's GitHub user

4	papers.bib (even if owned by someone else; deduplicated), and save to

9	  history       cumulative star total per day, from stargazer timestamps

12	other repos keep their cached counts, so a transient failure never shrinks the total.
13	Failed fetches fall back to cached values/history and the script exits 1.
14	
15	Usage: python _scripts/fetch_github_stars.py
16	"""

18	import json
19	import os
20	import re
21	import sys
22	import urllib.request
23	import urllib.error

45	def extract_github_repos(bib_path: str) -> list[str]:
46	    """Extract all github_repo values from a .bib file."""
47	    pattern = re.compile(r"github_repo\s*=\s*\{([^}]+)\}")
48	    repos = []
49	    with open(bib_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
50	        for match in pattern.finditer(f.read()):
51	            repo = match.group(1).strip()
52	            if repo and repo not in repos:
53	                repos.append(repo)

57	def read_github_username(config_path: str) -> str | None:
58	    """Read github_username from _config.yml (regex only; pyyaml isn't installed in CI)."""
59	    try:

61	            text = f.read()
62	    except OSError as e:

64	        return None
65	    match = re.search(r"^github_username:[ \t]*(.*)$", text, re.MULTILINE)
66	    if not match:
67	        return None
68	    value = re.sub(r"(?:^|\s)#.*$", "", match.group(1)).strip().strip("'\"").strip()

74	    headers = {

78	    if TOKEN:

80	
81	    repos = {}

84	        req = urllib.request.Request(USER_REPOS_API.format(user, page), headers=headers)
85	        try:

87	                items = json.loads(resp.read().decode())

120	    except Exception as e:

133	
134	    dates = []

136	    while True:
137	        req = urllib.request.Request(STARGAZERS_API.format(repo, page), headers=headers)
138	        try:

140	                items = json.loads(resp.read().decode())
141	        except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
142	            detail = e.read().decode(errors="replace")[:300]
143	            needed = e.headers.get("X-Accepted-GitHub-Permissions", "n/a")
144	            print(f"  HTTP {e.code} for {repo} stargazers: {e.reason} {detail} (accepted permissions: {needed})", file=sys.stderr)
145	            return None

148	            return None

155	        page += 1
156	    return dates

159	def build_history(dates: list[str]) -> list[dict]:
160	    """Cumulative star total after each calendar day on which stars were added."""
161	    history = []
162	    running = 0
163	    for day, count in sorted(Counter(dates).items()):
164	        running += count

186

196	    bib_repos = extract_github_repos(BIB_PATH)

1	// Publications page growth cards: draws cumulative citation / GitHub star
2	// curves from the #growth-data JSON emitted by _pages/publications.md.
3	(() => {
4	  const SVG_NS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";
5	  const NO_CHART_CLASS = "growth-card--no-chart";
6	  const DAY_MS = 86400000;
7	  const VIEW_W = 100;
8	  const VIEW_H = 40;
9	  const PAD_TOP = 3;
10	  const PAD_BOTTOM = 1;
11	  const MONTHS = ["Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun", "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec"];
12	  const STOPS = [
13	    ["0", "var(--ai-c1, #0894ff)"],
14	    ["0.34", "var(--ai-c2, #c959dd)"],
15	    ["0.68", "var(--ai-c3, #ff2e54)"],
16	    ["1", "var(--ai-c4, #ff9004)"],
17	  ];
18	
19	  // --- Pure helpers: series + geometry (no DOM) ---------------------------
20	
21	  const toNumber = (value) => (value === null || value === undefined || value === "" ? NaN : Number(value));
22	
23	  const parseDay = (value) => {
24	    const match = /^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})/.exec(String(value || ""));
25	    return match ? Date.UTC(Number(match[1]), Number(match[2]) - 1, Number(match[3])) : NaN;
26	  };
27	
28	  const todayUtc = (now) => Date.UTC(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate());
29	
30	  const monthLabel = (time) => {
31	    const date = new Date(time);
32	    return `${MONTHS[date.getUTCMonth()]} ${date.getUTCFullYear()}`;
33	  };
34	
35	  // Sort by time, drop invalid points, merge same-day points (later one wins).
36	  const normalize = (points) => {
37	    const merged = [];
38	    points
39	      .filter((point) => Number.isFinite(point.t) && Number.isFinite(point.v))
40	      .sort((a, b) => a.t - b.t)
41	      .forEach((point) => {
42	        const last = merged[merged.length - 1];
43	        if (last && point.t <= last.t) last.v = point.v;
44	        else merged.push({ t: point.t, v: point.v });
45	      });
46	    return merged;
47	  };
48	
49	  // Per-year (non-cumulative) Scholar counts -> cumulative curve from Jan 1 of
50	  // the first year to today. A larger reported total (Scholar lag) wins at the end.
51	  const citationSeries = (perYear, total, today) => {
52	    if (!perYear || typeof perYear !== "object" || Array.isArray(perYear)) return null;
53	    const years = Object.keys(perYear)
54	      .map(Number)
55	      .filter((year) => Number.isInteger(year) && year > 1900);
56	    if (!years.length) return null;
57	    const first = Math.min(...years);
58	    const currentYear = new Date(today).getUTCFullYear();
59	    const last = Math.max(Math.max(...years), currentYear);
60	    const points = [{ t: Date.UTC(first, 0, 1), v: 0 }];
61	    let sum = 0;
62	    for (let year = first; year <= last; year += 1) {
63	      const count = toNumber(perYear[year]);
64	      sum += Number.isFinite(count) && count > 0 ? count : 0;
65	      points.push({ t: year >= currentYear ? today : Date.UTC(year, 11, 31), v: sum });
66	    }
67	    const series = normalize(points);
68	    if (series.length < 2) return null;
69	    const end = series[series.length - 1];
70	    const reported = toNumber(total);
71	    if (Number.isFinite(reported) && reported > end.v) end.v = reported;
72	    return { points: series, start: String(first), end: String(new Date(end.t).getUTCFullYear()) };
73	  };
74	
75	  // Dated cumulative star totals -> curve starting at 0 the day before the
76	  // first record and ending today at the reported total.
77	  const starSeries = (history, total, today) => {
78	    if (!Array.isArray(history)) return null;
79	    const rows = normalize(history.map((row) => ({ t: parseDay(row && row.date), v: toNumber(row && row.stars) })));
80	    if (!rows.length) return null;
81	    const lastRow = rows[rows.length - 1];
82	    const reported = toNumber(total);
83	    const points = normalize([
84	      { t: rows[0].t - DAY_MS, v: 0 },
85	      ...rows,
86	      { t: Math.max(today, lastRow.t), v: Number.isFinite(reported) ? reported : lastRow.v },
87	    ]);
88	    if (points.length < 2) return null;
89	    return { points, start: monthLabel(rows[0].t), end: monthLabel(points[points.length - 1].t) };
90	  };
91	
92	  // Map {t, v} into the 100x40 viewBox; y runs from 0 (bottom) to the max value.
93	  const project = (points) => {
94	    const t0 = points[0].t;
95	    const span = points[points.length - 1].t - t0 || 1;
96	    const max = Math.max(1, ...points.map((point) => point.v));
97	    const height = VIEW_H - PAD_TOP - PAD_BOTTOM;
98	    return points.map((point) => ({
99	      x: ((point.t - t0) / span) * VIEW_W,
100	      y: VIEW_H - PAD_BOTTOM - (Math.max(0, point.v) / max) * height,
101	    }));
102	  };
103	
104	  const fmt = (value) => String(Math.round(value * 1000) / 1000);
105	
106	  // Monotone cubic interpolation (Fritsch–Carlson): smooth, never overshoots.
107	  const monotonePath = (pts) => {
108	    const n = pts.length;
109	    if (n < 2) return "";
110	    const h = [];
111	    const d = [];
112	    for (let i = 0; i < n - 1; i += 1) {
113	      h[i] = pts[i + 1].x - pts[i].x;
114	      d[i] = h[i] > 0 ? (pts[i + 1].y - pts[i].y) / h[i] : 0;
115	    }
116	    const m = new Array(n);
117	    m[0] = d[0];
118	    m[n - 1] = d[n - 2];
119	    for (let i = 1; i < n - 1; i += 1) m[i] = d[i - 1] * d[i] <= 0 ? 0 : (d[i - 1] + d[i]) / 2;
120	    for (let i = 0; i < n - 1; i += 1) {
121	      if (d[i] === 0) {
122	        m[i] = 0;
123	        m[i + 1] = 0;
124	      } else {
125	        const a = m[i] / d[i];
126	        const b = m[i + 1] / d[i];
127	        const s = a * a + b * b;
128	        if (s > 9) {
129	          const tau = 3 / Math.sqrt(s);
130	          m[i] = tau * a * d[i];
131	          m[i + 1] = tau * b * d[i];
132	        }
133	      }
134	    }
135	    let path = `M${fmt(pts[0].x)},${fmt(pts[0].y)}`;
136	    for (let i = 0; i < n - 1; i += 1) {
137	      const third = h[i] / 3;
138	      path +=
139	        `C${fmt(pts[i].x + third)},${fmt(pts[i].y + m[i] * third)} ` +
140	        `${fmt(pts[i + 1].x - third)},${fmt(pts[i + 1].y - m[i + 1] * third)} ` +
141	        `${fmt(pts[i + 1].x)},${fmt(pts[i + 1].y)}`;
142	    }
143	    return path;
144	  };
145

151	    return element;
152	  };
